section ‹Concatenation of languages›

theory Finite_State_Machines_ZF_1 imports Finite_State_Machines_ZF

begin

subsection‹Concatenation of regular languages›

text‹We now prove the main theorem: the concatenation of two regular
languages is regular.  The proof constructs an ‹ε›-NFSA that first
simulates the automaton for ‹L⇩1›, then makes a free ‹ε›-transition
to the initial state of the automaton for ‹L⇩2› upon reaching an
accepting state of the first, and finally accepts when the second
automaton accepts.›

text‹The combined state space for the product ‹ε›-NFSA is the
disjoint union ‹S⇩1×{0}∪S⇩2×{1}›.›

definition concat_eNFSA_states where
  "concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2) ≡ S1×{0} ∪ S2×{1}"

text‹The transition function of the product ‹ε›-NFSA.
A state ‹⟨s,0⟩› in the first component reads ‹a∈Σ› by following
‹t⇩1›; on the ‹ε›-symbol (encoded as ‹Σ›) it jumps to
‹⟨s⇩02,1⟩› when ‹s∈F⇩1›, and has no ‹ε›-move otherwise.
A state ‹⟨s,1⟩› in the second component reads ‹a∈Σ› by following
‹t⇩2›, and ignores ‹ε›-steps.›

definition concat_eNFSA_trans where
  "Finite(Σ) ⟹
   (S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ ⟹
   (S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ ⟹
   concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ) ≡
     {⟨⟨⟨s,0⟩,q⟩, {t1`⟨s,q⟩}×{0}⟩. ⟨s,q⟩∈S1×Σ}
     ∪ {⟨⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩, {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}⟩. s∈S1}
     ∪ {⟨⟨⟨s,1⟩,q⟩, {t2`⟨s,q⟩}×{1}⟩. ⟨s,q⟩∈S2×Σ}
     ∪ {⟨⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩, 0⟩. s∈S2}"

text‹The product automaton is a valid ‹ε›-NFSA.›

lemma concat_eNFSA_valid:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  shows "(concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2), ⟨s01,0⟩,
  concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ), F2×{1}
  ){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
proof-
  have S1fin:"Finite(S1)" and S2fin:"Finite(S2)"
    and s01S:"s01∈S1" and s02S:"s02∈S2"
    and F1S:"F1⊆S1" and F2S:"F2⊆S2"
    and t1:"t1:S1×Σ → S1" and t2:"t2:S2×Σ → S2"
    using A1 A2 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  let ?SS = "concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  let ?tc = "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  have finS10:"Finite(S1×{0})"
    using Finite1_L12[of S1 "{0}"] Fin_into_Finite Finite_into_Fin S1fin by auto
  have finS21:"Finite(S2×{1})"
    using Finite1_L12[of S2 "{1}"] Fin_into_Finite Finite_into_Fin S2fin by auto
  have finSS:"Finite(?SS)" unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def
    using finS10 finS21 Finite_Un by auto
  have s01SS:"⟨s01,0⟩∈?SS" unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def using s01S by auto
  have F2SS:"F2×{1} ⊆ ?SS" unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def using F2S by auto
  have tc_type:"?tc : ?SS×succ(Σ) → Pow(?SS)"
  proof-
    have ran:"?tc ∈ Pow((?SS×succ(Σ))×Pow(?SS))"
    proof-
      {
        fix t assume t:"t∈?tc"
        then obtain x y where tt:"⟨x,y⟩ = t" unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
        with t have xy:"⟨x,y⟩∈?tc" by auto
        have xy_dom:"x∈?SS×succ(Σ)"
          using xy unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2]
                             concat_eNFSA_states_def
          by (auto intro: succI1 succI2)
        have xy_img:"y⊆?SS"
        proof-
          from xy consider
            (a) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S1×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,aa⟩ ∧ y={t1`⟨s,aa⟩}×{0}" |
            (b) "∃s. s∈S1 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ y={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}" |
            (c) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S2×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,aa⟩ ∧ y={t2`⟨s,aa⟩}×{1}" |
            (d) "∃s. s∈S2 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ y=0"
            unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
          then show "y⊆?SS"
          proof cases
            case a
            then obtain s aa where sa:"⟨s,aa⟩∈S1×Σ" "y={t1`⟨s,aa⟩}×{0}" by auto
            from sa(1) have "t1`⟨s,aa⟩∈S1" using apply_type[OF t1] by auto
            with sa(2) show ?thesis unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
          next
            case b
            then obtain s where sb:"s∈S1" "y={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}" by auto
            then show ?thesis using s02S F2S unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
          next
            case c
            then obtain s aa where sa:"⟨s,aa⟩∈S2×Σ" "y={t2`⟨s,aa⟩}×{1}" by auto
            from sa(1) have "t2`⟨s,aa⟩∈S2" using apply_type[OF t2] by auto
            with sa(2) show ?thesis unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
          next
            case d then show ?thesis by auto
          qed
        qed
        from xy_dom xy_img have "⟨x,y⟩∈(?SS×succ(Σ))×Pow(?SS)" by auto
        with tt have "t∈(?SS×succ(Σ))×Pow(?SS)" by auto
      }
      then show ?thesis by auto
    qed
    moreover have "function(?tc)"
    proof -
      {
        fix x y z
        assume h1:"⟨x,y⟩∈?tc" and h2:"⟨x,z⟩∈?tc"
        from h1 consider
          (a1) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S1×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,aa⟩ ∧ y={t1`⟨s,aa⟩}×{0}" |
          (b1) "∃s. s∈S1 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ y={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}" |
          (c1) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S2×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,aa⟩ ∧ y={t2`⟨s,aa⟩}×{1}" |
          (d1) "∃s. s∈S2 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ y=0"
          unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
        then have "y=z"
        proof cases
          case a1
          then obtain s aa where sa:"⟨s,aa⟩∈S1×Σ" "x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,aa⟩" "y={t1`⟨s,aa⟩}×{0}" by auto
          from h2 consider
            (a2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S1×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,aa⟩ ∧ z={t1`⟨s,aa⟩}×{0}" |
            (b2) "∃s. s∈S1 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ z={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}" |
            (c2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S2×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,aa⟩ ∧ z={t2`⟨s,aa⟩}×{1}" |
            (d2) "∃s. s∈S2 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ z=0"
          unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
          then show ?thesis
          proof cases
            case a2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S1×Σ" "x=⟨⟨p,0⟩,q⟩" "z={t1`⟨p,q⟩}×{0}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(2) have "p=s" "q=aa" by auto
            with sa(3) pq(3) show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case b2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S1" "x=⟨⟨p,0⟩,Σ⟩" "z={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. p∈F1}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case c2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S2×Σ" "x=⟨⟨p,1⟩,q⟩" "z={t2`⟨p,q⟩}×{1}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case d2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S2" "x=⟨⟨p,1⟩,Σ⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
          qed
        next
          case b1
          then obtain s where sa:"s∈S1" "x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩" "y={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}" by auto
          from h2 consider
            (a2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S1×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,aa⟩ ∧ z={t1`⟨s,aa⟩}×{0}" |
            (b2) "∃s. s∈S1 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ z={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}" |
            (c2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S2×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,aa⟩ ∧ z={t2`⟨s,aa⟩}×{1}" |
            (d2) "∃s. s∈S2 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ z=0"
          unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
          then show ?thesis
          proof cases
            case a2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S1×Σ" "x=⟨⟨p,0⟩,q⟩" "z={t1`⟨p,q⟩}×{0}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case b2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S1" "x=⟨⟨p,0⟩,Σ⟩" "z={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. p∈F1}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have "p=s" by auto
            with sa(3) pq(3) show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case c2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S2×Σ" "x=⟨⟨p,1⟩,q⟩" "z={t2`⟨p,q⟩}×{1}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case d2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S2" "x=⟨⟨p,1⟩,Σ⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
          qed
        next
          case c1
          then obtain s aa where sa:"⟨s,aa⟩∈S2×Σ" "x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,aa⟩" "y={t2`⟨s,aa⟩}×{1}" by auto
          from h2 consider
            (a2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S1×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,aa⟩ ∧ z={t1`⟨s,aa⟩}×{0}" |
            (b2) "∃s. s∈S1 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ z={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}" |
            (c2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S2×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,aa⟩ ∧ z={t2`⟨s,aa⟩}×{1}" |
            (d2) "∃s. s∈S2 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ z=0"
          unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
          then show ?thesis
          proof cases
            case a2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S1×Σ" "x=⟨⟨p,0⟩,q⟩" "z={t1`⟨p,q⟩}×{0}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sa(2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case b2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S1" "x=⟨⟨p,0⟩,Σ⟩" "z={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. p∈F1}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case c2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S2×Σ" "x=⟨⟨p,1⟩,q⟩" "z={t2`⟨p,q⟩}×{1}" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have "p=s" "q=aa" by auto
            with sa(3) pq(3) show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case d2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S2" "x=⟨⟨p,1⟩,Σ⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(2) sa(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
          qed
        next
          case d1
          then obtain s where sb:"s∈S2" "x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩" "y=0" by auto
          from h2 consider
            (a2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S1×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,aa⟩ ∧ z={t1`⟨s,aa⟩}×{0}" |
            (b2) "∃s. s∈S1 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ z={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}" |
            (c2) "∃s aa. ⟨s,aa⟩∈S2×Σ ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,aa⟩ ∧ z={t2`⟨s,aa⟩}×{1}" |
            (d2) "∃s. s∈S2 ∧ x=⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩ ∧ z=0"
          unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
          then show ?thesis
          proof cases
            case a2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S1×Σ" "x=⟨⟨p,0⟩,q⟩" "z={t1`⟨p,q⟩}×{0}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sb(2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case b2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S1" "x=⟨⟨p,0⟩,Σ⟩" "z={x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. p∈F1}" by auto
            from pq(2) sb(1,2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case c2
            then obtain p q where pq:"⟨p,q⟩∈S2×Σ" "x=⟨⟨p,1⟩,q⟩" "z={t2`⟨p,q⟩}×{1}" by auto
            from pq(1,2) sb(2) have False using mem_irrefl by auto
            then show ?thesis by auto
            next
            case d2
            then obtain p where pq:"p∈S2" "x=⟨⟨p,1⟩,Σ⟩" "z=0" by auto
            from pq(2) sb(1,2) have "p=s" by auto
            with sb(3) pq(3) show ?thesis by auto
            next
          qed
        qed
      }
      then show ?thesis unfolding function_def by auto
    qed
    moreover have "?SS×succ(Σ) ⊆ domain(?tc)"
    proof
      fix x assume hx:"x∈?SS×succ(Σ)"
      then obtain p aa where pa:"p∈?SS" "aa∈succ(Σ)" "x=⟨p,aa⟩" by auto
      from pa(1) obtain s where ps:
        "(s∈S1 ∧ p=⟨s,0⟩) ∨ (s∈S2 ∧ p=⟨s,1⟩)"
        unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
      from pa(2) have acase:"aa∈Σ ∨ aa=Σ" using succ_iff by auto
      from ps show "x∈domain(?tc)"
      proof (elim disjE conjE)
        assume hs1:"s∈S1" and hsp1:"p=⟨s,0⟩"
        from acase show ?thesis
        proof (elim disjE)
          assume "aa∈Σ"
          with hs1 hsp1 pa(3) have "⟨x,{t1`⟨s,aa⟩}×{0}⟩∈?tc"
            unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
          then show ?thesis unfolding domain_def by auto
        next
          assume "aa=Σ"
          with hs1 hsp1 pa(3) have "⟨x,{v∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}⟩∈?tc"
            unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
          then show ?thesis unfolding domain_def by auto
        qed
      next
        assume hs2:"s∈S2" and hsp2:"p=⟨s,1⟩"
        from acase show ?thesis
        proof (elim disjE)
          assume "aa∈Σ"
          with hs2 hsp2 pa(3) have "⟨x,{t2`⟨s,aa⟩}×{1}⟩∈?tc"
            unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
          then show ?thesis unfolding domain_def by auto
        next
          assume "aa=Σ"
          with hs2 hsp2 pa(3) have "⟨x,0⟩∈?tc"
            unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
          then show ?thesis unfolding domain_def by auto
        qed
      qed
    qed
    ultimately show ?thesis unfolding Pi_def by auto
  qed
  show ?thesis unfolding FullNFSA_def[OF fin]
    using finSS s01SS F2SS tc_type by auto
qed

text‹The $\varepsilon$-transition of a component-0 state $\langle s,0\rangle$
is $\{\langle s_{02},1\rangle\}$ when $s\in F_1$, and empty otherwise.›

lemma concat_eNFSA_eps_comp0:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and sS1:"s∈S1"
  shows "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)`⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩
         = {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}"
proof-
  let ?tc = "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  let ?SS = "concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  have fsa:"(?SS,⟨s01,0⟩,?tc,F2×{1}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] .
  have tT:"?tc : ?SS×succ(Σ) → Pow(?SS)"
    using fsa unfolding FullNFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have pair:"⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩ ∈ ?SS×succ(Σ)"
    using sS1 unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by (auto intro: succI1)
  have "⟨⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩, {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s∈F1}⟩ ∈ ?tc"
    unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] using sS1 by auto
  then show ?thesis using apply_equality[OF _ tT, of "⟨⟨s,0⟩,Σ⟩"] pair by auto
qed

text‹The $\varepsilon$-transition of a component-1 state $\langle s,1\rangle$ is empty.›

lemma concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and sS2:"s∈S2"
  shows "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)`⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩ = 0"
proof-
  let ?tc = "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  let ?SS = "concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  have fsa:"(?SS,⟨s01,0⟩,?tc,F2×{1}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] .
  have tT:"?tc : ?SS×succ(Σ) → Pow(?SS)"
    using fsa unfolding FullNFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have pair:"⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩ ∈ ?SS×succ(Σ)"
    using sS2 unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by (auto intro: succI1)
  have "⟨⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩, 0⟩ ∈ ?tc"
    unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] using sS2 by auto
  then show ?thesis using apply_equality[OF _ tT, of "⟨⟨s,1⟩,Σ⟩"] pair by auto
qed

text‹The normal transition of a component-0 state $\langle s,0\rangle$
is a transition of the first DFSA.›

lemma concat_eNFSA_eps_comp0':
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and sS1:"s∈S1" and sig:"q∈Σ"
  shows "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)`⟨⟨s,0⟩,q⟩
         = {t1`⟨s,q⟩}×{0}"
proof-
  let ?tc = "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  let ?SS = "concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  have fsa:"(?SS,⟨s01,0⟩,?tc,F2×{1}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] .
  have tT:"?tc : ?SS×succ(Σ) → Pow(?SS)"
    using fsa unfolding FullNFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have pair:"⟨⟨s,0⟩,q⟩ ∈ ?SS×succ(Σ)"
    using sS1 sig unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have "⟨⟨⟨s,0⟩,q⟩, {t1`⟨s,q⟩}×{0}⟩ ∈ ?tc"
    unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] using sS1 sig by auto
  then show ?thesis using apply_equality[OF _ tT, of "⟨⟨s,0⟩,q⟩"] pair by auto
qed

text‹The normal transition of a component-1 state $\langle s,1\rangle$ is
a normal transition of the second DFSA.›

lemma concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1':
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and sS2:"s∈S2" and sig:"q∈Σ"
  shows "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)`⟨⟨s,1⟩,q⟩ = {t2`⟨s,q⟩}×{1}"
proof-
  let ?tc = "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  let ?SS = "concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  have fsa:"(?SS,⟨s01,0⟩,?tc,F2×{1}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] .
  have tT:"?tc : ?SS×succ(Σ) → Pow(?SS)"
    using fsa unfolding FullNFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have pair:"⟨⟨s,1⟩,q⟩ ∈ ?SS×succ(Σ)"
    using sS2 sig unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by (auto)
  have "⟨⟨⟨s,1⟩,q⟩, {t2`⟨s,q⟩}×{1}⟩ ∈ ?tc"
    unfolding concat_eNFSA_trans_def[OF fin A1 A2] using sS2 sig by auto
  then show ?thesis using apply_equality[OF _ tT, of "⟨⟨s,1⟩,q⟩"] pair by auto
qed

text‹The normal transition of a component-1 state $\langle s,1\rangle$ is
a normal transition of the second DFSA.›

lemma concat_eNFSA_eps_closure:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  defines "s⇩0 ≡ ⟨s01,0⟩"
  defines "F ≡ F2×{1}"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and sig:"q∈Pow(S)"
  shows "ε-cl(S,t,Σ,q) = q ∪ {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q∩(F1×1) ≠0}"
proof
  from sig have sub:"q ⊆ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)" unfolding S_def by auto
  {
    fix y assume "y∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,q)"
    then obtain P where P:"P∈Pow(S)" "y∈P" "⟨q,P⟩∈({⟨Q,{s∈S. ∃q∈Q. s ∈ t`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(S)}^*)"
      unfolding S_def t_def EpsilonClosure_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] sub] by auto
    let ?r = "{⟨Q,{s∈S. ∃q∈Q. s ∈ t`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(S)}"
    {
      assume "⟨q,P⟩∈id(field(?r))"
      then have "P=q" by auto
      with P(2) have "y:q" by auto
      then have "y: q ∪ {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q∩(F1×1) ≠0}" by auto
    } moreover
    {
      assume "⟨q,P⟩∉id(field(?r))"
      moreover from P(3) have "⟨q,P⟩∈id(field(?r))∪(?r O ?r^*)" using rtrancl_unfold by auto
      ultimately have "⟨q,P⟩∈(?r O ?r^*)" by auto
      then obtain Q where q:"⟨q,Q⟩∈?r^*" "⟨Q,P⟩∈?r" using compE by auto
      from q(2) have p:"P={s∈S. ∃u∈Q. s∈t`⟨u,Σ⟩}" "Q∈Pow(S)" by auto
      from P(2) p(1) obtain u where u:"u∈Q" "y∈t`⟨u,Σ⟩" by auto
      {
        assume "u∈S1×1"
        then obtain us where uu:"u=⟨us,0⟩" "us∈S1" by auto
        then have t:"t`⟨u,Σ⟩ = {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. us∈F1}" using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp0[OF fin A1 A2]
          unfolding t_def by auto
        {
          assume "us∉F1"
          with t have False using u(2) by auto
        }
        then have "us∈F1" by auto
        with t have "t`⟨u,Σ⟩ = {⟨s02,1⟩}" by auto
        with u(2) have "y=⟨s02,1⟩" by auto moreover
        from uu(1) `us∈F1` have "u∈F1×1" by auto
        ultimately have "u∈F1×1" "y=⟨s02,1⟩" by auto
      } moreover
      {
        assume as:"u∉S1×1"
        from u(1) p(2) have "u:(S1×1)∪(S2×{1})" unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def S_def by auto
        with as have "u∈S2×{1}" by auto
        then obtain sq where "sq∈S2" "u=⟨sq,1⟩" by auto
        then have t:"t`⟨u,Σ⟩ = 0" using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1[OF fin A1 A2] t_def by auto
        with u(2) have False by auto
      }
      ultimately
      have A:"u∈F1×{0}" "y=⟨s02,1⟩" by auto
      {
        assume "⟨q,Q⟩∈id(field(?r))"
        then have "q=Q" by auto
        with A(1) u(1) have "q∩(F1×1)≠0" by auto
        with A(2) have "y∈{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q∩(F1×1)≠0}" by auto
        then have "y∈q∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q∩(F1×1)≠0}" by auto
      } moreover
      {
        assume "⟨q,Q⟩∉id(field(?r))"
        moreover from q(1) have "⟨q,Q⟩∈id(field(?r))∪(?r O ?r^*)" using rtrancl_unfold by auto
        ultimately have "⟨q,Q⟩∈(?r O ?r^*)" by auto
        then obtain w where q:"⟨q,w⟩∈?r^*" "⟨w,Q⟩∈?r" using compE by auto
        from q(2) have "Q={s∈S. ∃g∈w. s∈t`⟨g,Σ⟩}" "w∈Pow(S)" by auto
        with u(1) obtain v where v:"v∈w" "u∈t`⟨v,Σ⟩" by auto
        {
           assume "v∈S1×1"
          then obtain us where uu:"v=⟨us,0⟩" "us∈S1" by auto
          then have t:"t`⟨v,Σ⟩ = {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. us∈F1}" using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp0[OF fin A1 A2]
            unfolding t_def by auto
          {
            assume "us∉F1"
            with t have False using v(2) by auto
          }
          then have "us∈F1" by auto
          with t have "t`⟨v,Σ⟩ = {⟨s02,1⟩}" by auto
          with v(2) have "u=⟨s02,1⟩" by auto
          with A(1) have False by auto
        }
        then have as:"v∉S1×1" by auto
        from v(1) `w∈Pow(S)` have "v:(S1×1)∪(S2×{1})" unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def S_def by auto
        with as have "v∈S2×{1}" by auto
        then obtain sq where "sq∈S2" "v=⟨sq,1⟩" by auto
        then have t:"t`⟨v,Σ⟩ = 0" using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1[OF fin A1 A2] t_def by auto
        with v(2) have False by auto
      } ultimately
      have "y∈q∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q∩(F1×1)≠0}" by blast
    } ultimately
    have "y∈q∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q∩(F1×1)≠0}" by blast
  }
  then show "ε-cl(S, t, Σ, q) ⊆
    q ∪
    {x ∈ {⟨s02, 1⟩}.
     q ∩ F1 × 1 ≠ ∅}" by blast
next
  from sig have sub:"q ⊆ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)" unfolding S_def by auto 
  from A1 have subSt:"F1 ⊆ S1" unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  from A2 have init2:"s02∈S2" unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  let ?r = "{⟨Q,{s∈S. ∃q∈Q. s ∈ t`⟨q,Σ⟩}⟩. Q∈Pow(S)}"
  {
    fix y assume as:"y∈q∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q∩(F1×1)≠0}"
    {
      assume "y∈q"
      then have "y∈ε-cl(S, t, Σ, q)" using epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] sub]
        S_def t_def by auto
    } moreover
    {
      assume "y∉q"
      with as have as:"y∈{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q∩(F1×1)≠0}" by auto
      {
        assume "q∩(F1×1) = 0"
        with as have False by auto
      }
      then have ne:"q∩(F1×1)≠0" by auto
      with as have y:"y=⟨s02,1⟩" by auto
      from ne obtain qq where qq:"qq∈F1" "⟨qq,0⟩∈q" by auto
      from qq(1) have "t`⟨⟨qq,0⟩,Σ⟩ = {y}" using y concat_eNFSA_eps_comp0[OF fin A1 A2, of qq] subSt t_def by auto
      then have "y:t`⟨⟨qq,0⟩,Σ⟩" by auto
      with qq(2) have "∃m∈q. y∈t`⟨m,Σ⟩" by blast
      moreover have "y:S" using y init2 S_def concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
      ultimately have B:"y∈{s∈S. ∃m∈q. s∈t`⟨m,Σ⟩}" by auto
      have "⟨q,{s∈S. ∃m∈q. s∈t`⟨m,Σ⟩}⟩∈?r" using sig by auto
      then have "⟨q,{s∈S. ∃m∈q. s∈t`⟨m,Σ⟩}⟩∈?r^*" using r_into_rtrancl by auto
      then have "{s∈S. ∃m∈q. s∈t`⟨m,Σ⟩} ⊆ ε-cl(S, t, Σ, q)"
        using EpsilonClosure_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] sub]
          S_def t_def by auto
      with B have "y∈ε-cl(S, t, Σ, q)" by auto
    }
    ultimately have "y∈ε-cl(S, t, Σ, q)" by auto
  }
  then show "q ∪
    {x ∈ {⟨s02, 1⟩}.
     q ∩ F1 × 1 ≠ ∅} ⊆ ε-cl(S, t, Σ, q)" by auto
qed

text‹Once L2 is reached, the relation is equivalent to its DFSA›

lemma concat_FSA_apply_L2_step:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  defines "s⇩0 ≡ ⟨s01,0⟩"
  defines "F ≡ F2×{1}"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and j:"⟨⟨j,p⟩,⟨r,q⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)^*" "j≠0"
  and states:"⟨p,1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,P)" "P∈Pow(S)"
  shows "∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨q,1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Q) ∧ (⟨⟨j,P⟩,⟨r,Q⟩⟩∈(({reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*))"
proof-
  let ?r="{reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ"
  from j(1) have "⟨j,p⟩∈field(({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)^*)" using fieldI1 by auto
  then have "⟨j,p⟩∈field({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)" using rtrancl_field by auto
  then have jl:"j∈Lists(Σ)" using DetFinStateAuto.reduce_field(1) A2 unfolding DetFinStateAuto_def
    using fin by blast
  have "∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨snd(⟨r, q⟩),1⟩ ∈ ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Q) ∧ ⟨⟨j, P⟩, fst(⟨r,q⟩), Q⟩ ∈ ?r^*"
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct[OF j(1), where P="λs. ∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨snd(s),1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Q) ∧ (⟨⟨j,P⟩,⟨fst(s),Q⟩⟩∈(?r^*))"])
    have "j∈NELists(Σ)" using non_zero_List_func_is_NEList j(2) jl by auto
    with states(2) have "⟨j,P⟩∈field(?r)" using eps_nfsa_field(2)[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
      S_def t_def s⇩0_def by auto
    then have "⟨⟨j,P⟩,⟨j,P⟩⟩∈?r^*" using rtrancl_refl by auto
    with states show "∃Q∈Pow(S).
      ⟨snd(⟨j, p⟩),1⟩ ∈ ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Q) ∧
      ⟨⟨j, P⟩, fst(⟨j, p⟩),
      Q⟩ ∈ ?r^*" by auto
  next
    fix y z assume as:"⟨⟨j,p⟩,y⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)^*" 
    "⟨y,z⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)" 
    "∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨snd(y),1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Q) ∧ ⟨⟨j,P⟩,fst(y),Q⟩∈?r^*" 
    from as(2) obtain yl ys where yz:"yl∈NELists(Σ)" "ys∈S2" "y=⟨yl,ys⟩" "z=⟨Init(yl),t2`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩⟩"
      unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A2] by auto
    from yz(3) as(3) obtain Qy where Q:"Qy∈Pow(S)" "⟨ys,1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)" "⟨⟨j,P⟩,yl,Qy⟩∈?r^*" by auto
    have "⟨⟨yl,Qy⟩,Init(yl),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})⟩∈?r"
      unfolding FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
          S_def t_def s⇩0_def using yz(1) Q(1) S_def by auto
    with Q(3) have "⟨⟨j,P⟩,Init(yl),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})⟩∈?r^*"
      using rtrancl_into_rtrancl by auto
    with yz(4) have A:"⟨⟨j,P⟩,fst(z),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})⟩∈?r^*" by auto
    from yz(1) have "Last(yl)∈Σ" using last_type by auto
    then have C1:"t`⟨⟨ys,1⟩,Last(yl)⟩={t2`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩}×{1}" using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1'[OF fin A1 A2 yz(2)]
      unfolding t_def by auto
    have tT:"t:S×succ(Σ)→Pow(S)" using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]
      unfolding t_def FullNFSA_def[OF fin] s⇩0_def S_def by auto
    have unionS:"⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)} ∈ Pow(S)"
    proof
      {
        fix x assume "x ∈ ⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)}"
        then obtain ss where ss:"ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)" "x∈t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩" by auto
        from Q(1) ss(1) have ssS:"ss∈S" using EpsilonClosure_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
          unfolding S_def t_def by auto
        have lastSig:"Last(yl)∈succ(Σ)" using last_type[OF yz(1)] by auto
        have "⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩∈S×succ(Σ)" using ssS lastSig by auto
        from apply_type[OF tT this] ss(2) have "x∈S" by auto
      }
      then show "⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)} ⊆ S" by auto
    qed
    then have B:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})∈Pow(S)" 
      using EpsilonClosure_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]] S_def t_def by auto
    then have D:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})) = ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})"
      using epsilon_cl_idem[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]] unionS S_def t_def by auto
    have "Qy ⊆ ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)" using epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
      using Q(1) S_def t_def by auto
    with Q(2) have s:"t`⟨⟨ys,1⟩,Last(yl)⟩ ⊆ ⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)}" by auto
    with unionS have C2:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,t`⟨⟨ys,1⟩,Last(yl)⟩) ⊆ ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})"
      using epsilon_cl_mono[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]] unfolding S_def t_def by auto
    from unionS s have "t`⟨⟨ys,1⟩,Last(yl)⟩ ⊆ S" by auto
    then have "t`⟨⟨ys,1⟩,Last(yl)⟩ ⊆ ε-cl(S,t,Σ,t`⟨⟨ys,1⟩,Last(yl)⟩)" using
      epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
      unfolding S_def t_def by auto
    with C1 C2 have "⟨t2`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩,1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})" by auto
    with D have C:"⟨t2`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩,1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(yl)⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)}))" by auto
    from A B C yz(4) show "∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨snd(z),1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Q) ∧ ⟨⟨j,P⟩,fst(z),Q⟩∈?r^*" by auto
  qed
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹Once the only thing left is a word in L2, it passes if s02 is one of the initial
states.›

lemma concat_FSA_apply_L2:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  defines "s⇩0 ≡ ⟨s01,0⟩"
  defines "F ≡ F2×{1}"
  defines "L1 ≡ {i∈Lists(Σ). i <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ}"
  defines "L2 ≡ {i∈Lists(Σ). i <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ}"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and j:"j∈L2" "⟨s02,1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Q)" "Q∈Pow(S)" "j≠0"
  shows "∃q∈Pow(S). ((ε-cl(S,t,Σ,q) ∩ F ≠ ∅) ∧ (⟨⟨j,Q⟩,⟨0,q⟩⟩∈(({reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)))"
proof-
  from j(4) j(1) have jne:"j∈NELists(Σ)" using non_zero_List_func_is_NEList unfolding L2_def by auto
  from j(1) have l2:"j <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ" "j∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding L2_def by auto
  from l2(1) j(4) have "∃q∈F2. ⟨⟨j, s02⟩, ∅, q⟩ ∈ ({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
    unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A2 l2(2)] by auto
  then obtain u where u:"u∈F2" "⟨⟨j,s02⟩,0,u⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
    by auto
  have "∃Qa∈Pow(S).
      ⟨u, 1⟩ ∈ ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qa) ∧
      ⟨⟨j, Q⟩, 0, Qa⟩ ∈
      ({reduce ε-N-relation} (S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
    using concat_FSA_apply_L2_step[OF fin A1 A2 u(2) j(4)] 
    j(2,3) unfolding S_def t_def s⇩0_def by auto
  then obtain H where h:"H∈Pow(S)" "⟨u,1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,H)" "⟨⟨j,Q⟩,0,H⟩∈({reduce ε-N-relation} (S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
    by auto
  from u(1) have "⟨u,1⟩∈F" unfolding F_def by auto
  moreover note h(2)
  ultimately have "ε-cl(S,t,Σ,H)∩F≠0" by auto
  with h(1,3) show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹Concatenating a list on the left of a non-empty list yields a non-empty list.›

text‹Step 2 (sub-goal of concat\_FSA\_apply\_L1\_step): Concat preserves the non-empty list property
when the right argument is non-empty.›

lemma concat_is_NElist:
  assumes "p∈Lists(X)" "b∈NELists(X)"
  shows "Concat(p,b)∈NELists(X)"
proof-
  from assms(1) obtain n where n:"n∈nat" "p:n→X" unfolding Lists_def by auto
  from assms(2) obtain k where k:"k∈nat" "b:succ(k)→X" unfolding NELists_def by auto
  from n k have Cab:"Concat(p,b):n#+succ(k)→X" using concat_props(1)[OF n(1) nat_succI[OF k(1)]] by auto
  from n(1) k(1) have eq:"n#+succ(k) = succ(n#+k)" using add_succ_right by auto
  from n(1) k(1) have nk:"n#+k∈nat" by auto
  with Cab eq have "Concat(p,b):succ(n#+k)→X" by auto
  then show ?thesis unfolding NELists_def using nk by auto
qed

text‹Step 3 (sub-goal of concat\_FSA\_apply\_L1\_step): The last element of a left-extended
non-empty list is the same as the last element of the original non-empty list.›

lemma concat_last_NElist:
  assumes "p∈Lists(X)" "b∈NELists(X)"
  shows "Last(Concat(p,b)) = Last(b)"
proof-
  from assms(1) obtain n where n:"n∈nat" "p:n→X" unfolding Lists_def by auto
  from assms(2) obtain k where k:"k∈nat" "b:succ(k)→X" unfolding NELists_def by auto
  from n k have Cab:"Concat(p,b):n#+succ(k)→X" using concat_props(1)[OF n(1) nat_succI[OF k(1)]] by auto
  from n(1) k(1) have eq:"n#+succ(k) = succ(n#+k)" using add_succ_right by auto
  from n(1) k(1) have nk:"n#+k∈nat" by auto
  with Cab eq have Cab':"Concat(p,b):succ(n#+k)→X" by auto
  have "Last(Concat(p,b)) = Concat(p,b)`(n#+k)" using last_seq_elem[OF Cab'] by auto
  also have "… = b`(k)" using concat_props(4)[OF n(1) nat_succI[OF k(1)] n(2) k(2)] by auto
  also have "… = Last(b)" using last_seq_elem[OF k(2)] by auto
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

text‹Step 4 (sub-goal of concat\_FSA\_apply\_L1\_step): Init distributes over Concat from the right:
init of the concatenation is the concatenation with the init of the right part.›

lemma concat_init_NElist:
  assumes "p∈Lists(X)" "b∈NELists(X)"
  shows "Init(Concat(p,b)) = Concat(p,Init(b))"
proof-
  from assms(1) obtain n where n:"n∈nat" "p:n→X" unfolding Lists_def by auto
  from assms(2) obtain k where k:"k∈nat" "b:succ(k)→X" unfolding NELists_def by auto
  have ib:"Init(b):k→X" using init_props(1)[OF k(1) k(2)] by auto
  have Cib:"Concat(p,Init(b)):n#+k→X" using concat_props(1)[OF n(1) k(1) n(2) ib] by auto
  from k(2) have bk:"b`(k)∈X" using apply_funtype by auto
  from n(1) k(1) have nk:"n#+k∈nat" by auto
  have key:"Append(Concat(p,Init(b)),b`(k)) = Concat(p,b)"
    using concat_init_last_elem[OF n(1) k(1) n(2) k(2)] by auto
  have "Init(Append(Concat(p,Init(b)),b`(k))) = Concat(p,Init(b))"
    using init_append[OF nk Cib bk] by auto
  with key show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹Running a word of the form Concat(v,j) to v in a DFSA is
the same as running j from the same starting state.›

lemma (in DetFinStateAuto) dfa_run_suffix:
  assumes vL:"v∈Lists(Σ)" and jNE:"j∈NELists(Σ)"
    and run:"⟨⟨Concat(v,j),s⟩,⟨v,q⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*"
  shows "⟨⟨j,s⟩,⟨0,q⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*"
proof-
  from jNE obtain n where n:"n∈nat" "j:succ(n)→Σ" unfolding NELists_def by auto
  let ?P="λk. ∀v∈Lists(Σ). ∀j. j:succ(k)→Σ ⟶
      (∀s q. ⟨⟨Concat(v,j),s⟩,⟨v,q⟩⟩∈r⇩D^* ⟶ ⟨⟨j,s⟩,⟨0,q⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*)"
  ― ‹Base case: j is a one-element list›
  have base:"?P(0)"
  proof(intro ballI allI impI)
    fix v' j' s' q'
    assume vL':"v'∈Lists(Σ)" and j1':"j':succ(0)→Σ"
      and run1':"⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*"
    from j1' nat_0I have jNE':"j'∈NELists(Σ)" unfolding NELists_def by auto
    from j1' nat_0I have initj':"Init(j'):0→Σ" using init_props(1)[of 0 j'] by auto
    then have initj'0:"Init(j')=0" unfolding Pi_def function_def by auto
    have lastj':"Last(j')∈Σ" using last_type[OF jNE'] by auto
    have Cvj':"Concat(v',j')∈NELists(Σ)" using concat_is_NElist[OF vL' jNE'] by auto
    ― ‹Extract first step: id case is impossible because domains differ›
    have "⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩ ∈ id(field(r⇩D)) ∪ (r⇩D^* O r⇩D)"
      using rtrancl_rev[of r⇩D] run1' by auto
    then have "⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩ ∈ r⇩D^* O r⇩D"
    proof
      assume id:"⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩∈id(field(r⇩D))"
      then have ceq:"Concat(v',j')=v'" by auto
      from vL' obtain m where m:"m∈nat" "v':m→Σ" unfolding Lists_def by auto
      have "Concat(v',j'):m#+succ(0)→Σ" using concat_props(1)[OF m(1) nat_succI[OF nat_0I] m(2) j1'] by auto
      with ceq m(2) have "m#+succ(0) = m" using domain_of_fun[of v' m "λ_. Σ"] domain_of_fun[of "Concat(v',j')" "m #+ 1" "λ_. Σ"] by auto
      with m(1) have "succ(m) = m" using add_succ_right by auto moreover
      have "m∈succ(m)" by auto
      ultimately have "m∈m" using subst[of "succ(m)" m "λq. m∈q"] by blast
      then show ?thesis using mem_irrefl[of m] by auto
    next
      assume "⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩ ∈ r⇩D^* O r⇩D" 
      then show "⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩ ∈ r⇩D^* O r⇩D" .
    qed
    then have "⋀P. (⋀y. ⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,y⟩∈r⇩D ⟹ ⟨y,⟨v',q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^* ⟹ P) ⟹ P"
      using compE[of "⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩" "r⇩D" "r⇩D^*"] by auto
    then obtain y where step:"⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,y⟩∈r⇩D" "⟨y,⟨v',q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*" .
    from step(1) have yww:
      "y=⟨Init(Concat(v',j')),t`⟨s',Last(Concat(v',j'))⟩⟩"
      unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF finite_alphabet DFSA] by auto
    have lastEq:"Last(Concat(v',j'))=Last(j')" using concat_last_NElist[OF vL' jNE'] by auto
    have initEq:"Init(Concat(v',j'))=Concat(v',Init(j'))"
      using concat_init_NElist[OF vL' jNE'] by auto
    from yww lastEq initEq initj'0 have yeq:
      "y=⟨Concat(v',0),t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩" by auto
    have "Concat(v',0)=v'" using concat_empty vL' unfolding Lists_def by auto
    with yeq have yeq2:"y=⟨v',t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩" by auto
    ― ‹Remaining run from v' forces q'=t(s',Last(j'))›
    from step(2) yeq2 have remrun:"⟨⟨v',t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*" by auto
    from remrun have "⟨v',t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩∈field(r⇩D)"
      using rtrancl_field relation_field_times_field[OF relation_rtrancl[of r⇩D]] by auto
    then have rfld:"⟨⟨v',t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩,⟨v',t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*"
      using rtrancl_refl by auto
    from remrun rfld have q'eq:"q'=t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩" using relation_deteministic by blast
    ― ‹One step on j' gives the conclusion›
    have jstep:"⟨⟨j',s'⟩,⟨Init(j'),t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩⟩∈r⇩D"
  using step(1) unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF finite_alphabet DFSA]
      using jNE' by auto
    from jstep initj'0 q'eq show "⟨⟨j',s'⟩,⟨0,q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*"
      using r_into_rtrancl by auto
  qed
  ― ‹Inductive step: Init(j) has type succ(k), apply IH›
  have step:"⋀k. k∈nat ⟹ ?P(k) ⟹ ?P(succ(k))"
  proof-
    fix k assume kn:"k∈nat" and IH:"?P(k)"
    show "?P(succ(k))"
    proof(intro ballI allI impI)
    fix v' j' s' q'
    assume vL':"v'∈Lists(Σ)" and jk':"j':succ(succ(k))→Σ"
      and run':"⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*"
    from jk' nat_succI[OF kn] have jNE':"j'∈NELists(Σ)" unfolding NELists_def by auto
    from jk' kn have initj':"Init(j'):succ(k)→Σ" using init_props(1)[OF nat_succI[OF kn]] by auto
    then have initjNE':"Init(j')∈NELists(Σ)" unfolding NELists_def using kn by auto
    have lastj':"Last(j')∈Σ" using last_type[OF jNE'] by auto
    have Cvj':"Concat(v',j')∈NELists(Σ)" using concat_is_NElist[OF vL' jNE'] by auto
    ― ‹Extract first step›
    have "⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩ ∈ id(field(r⇩D)) ∪ (r⇩D^* O r⇩D)"
      using rtrancl_rev[of r⇩D] run' by auto
    then have "⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩ ∈ r⇩D^* O r⇩D"
    proof
      assume id:"⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩∈id(field(r⇩D))"
      then have ceq:"Concat(v',j')=v'" by auto
      from vL' obtain m where m:"m∈nat" "v':m→Σ" unfolding Lists_def by auto
      have A:"Concat(v',j'):m#+succ(succ(k))→Σ" using concat_props(1)[OF m(1) _ m(2) jk'] nat_succI kn by auto
      from ceq have "domain(Concat(v',j')) = domain(v')" by auto
      with A have "m#+succ(succ(k)) = domain(v')" using domain_of_fun[of "Concat(v',j')" "m #+ succ(succ(k))" "λ_. Σ"]
        by auto
      with m(2) have "m#+succ(succ(k)) = m" using domain_of_fun[of v' m "λ_. Σ"] by blast
      with m(1) have "succ(m) = m" using add_succ_right by auto moreover
      have "m∈succ(m)" by auto
      ultimately have "m∈m" using subst[of "succ(m)" m "λq. m∈q"] by blast
      then show ?thesis using mem_irrefl[of m] by auto
    next
      assume "⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩ ∈ r⇩D^* O r⇩D" 
      then show ?thesis by assumption
    qed
    then obtain y where step':"⟨⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩,y⟩∈r⇩D" "⟨y,⟨v',q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*"
      using compE by auto
    from step'(1) obtain ww ss where yww:
      "ww∈NELists(Σ)" "ss∈S" "y=⟨Init(ww),t`⟨ss,Last(ww)⟩⟩"
      "⟨Concat(v',j'),s'⟩=⟨ww,ss⟩"
      unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF finite_alphabet DFSA] by auto
    from yww(4) have wweq:"ww=Concat(v',j')" "ss=s'" by auto
    have lastEq:"Last(Concat(v',j'))=Last(j')" using concat_last_NElist[OF vL' jNE'] by auto
    have initEq:"Init(Concat(v',j'))=Concat(v',Init(j'))"
      using concat_init_NElist[OF vL' jNE'] by auto
    from yww(3) wweq lastEq initEq have yeq:
      "y=⟨Concat(v',Init(j')),t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩" by auto
    from step'(2) yeq have remrun:
      "⟨⟨Concat(v',Init(j')),t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩,⟨v',q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*" by auto
    ― ‹Apply IH to Init(j') to get run from Init(j')›
    from IH initj' vL' have
      "∀s'' q''. ⟨⟨Concat(v',Init(j')),s''⟩,⟨v',q''⟩⟩∈r⇩D^* ⟶
          ⟨⟨Init(j'),s''⟩,⟨0,q''⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*" by auto
    with remrun have IHresult:
      "⟨⟨Init(j'),t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩,⟨0,q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*" by auto
    ― ‹One step on j' then chain›
    have jstep:"⟨⟨j',s'⟩,⟨Init(j'),t`⟨s',Last(j')⟩⟩⟩∈r⇩D"
      unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF finite_alphabet DFSA]
      using jNE' yww(2) wweq(2) by auto
    from jstep IHresult show "⟨⟨j',s'⟩,⟨0,q'⟩⟩∈r⇩D^*"
      using rtrancl_into_trancl2 trancl_into_rtrancl by auto
    qed
  qed
  from step have "?P(n)" using nat_induct[of _ ?P, OF n(1) base] by auto
  with vL n(2) run show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹If a DFSA run reduces word w to word v, then v is an initial prefix of w,
i.e., there exists a suffix j with w = Concat(v,j).›

lemma (in DetFinStateAuto) list_prefix_split:
  assumes run: "⟨⟨w,s⟩,⟨v,q⟩⟩ ∈ r⇩D^*"
  shows "∃ j∈Lists(Σ). w = Concat(v,j)"
proof-
  have wL: "w∈Lists(Σ)"
  proof-
    from run have "⟨w,s⟩∈field(r⇩D^*)" using fieldI1 by auto
    then have "⟨w,s⟩∈field(r⇩D)"
      using rtrancl_field[of r⇩D] relation_field_times_field[OF relation_rtrancl[of r⇩D]] by auto
    then show ?thesis using reduce_field(1) by auto
  qed
  have "∃j∈Lists(Σ). w = Concat(fst(⟨v,q⟩),j)"
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct[OF run, where P="λz. ∃j∈Lists(Σ). w = Concat(fst(z),j)"])
    have z:"0∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding Lists_def Pi_def function_def using nat_0I by auto
    from wL have "Concat(fst(⟨w,s⟩),0) = w" using concat_empty unfolding Lists_def by auto
    with z show "∃j∈Lists(Σ). w = Concat(fst(⟨w,s⟩),j)" using exI[of "λj. j∈Lists(Σ) ∧ w= Concat(fst(⟨w,s⟩),j)" 0]
      by auto
  next
    fix y z
    assume "⟨⟨w,s⟩,y⟩∈r⇩D^*" "⟨y,z⟩∈r⇩D" "∃j∈Lists(Σ). w = Concat(fst(y),j)"
    from ‹⟨y,z⟩∈r⇩D› obtain y1 y2 where y:
      "y1∈NELists(Σ)" "y2∈S" "y=⟨y1,y2⟩" "z=⟨Init(y1),t`⟨y2,Last(y1)⟩⟩"
      unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF finite_alphabet DFSA] by auto
    from ‹∃j∈Lists(Σ). w = Concat(fst(y),j)› y(3) obtain j where j:
      "j∈Lists(Σ)" "w = Concat(y1,j)" by auto
    from j(1) obtain m where m:"m∈nat" "j:m→Σ" unfolding Lists_def by auto
    from y(1) obtain n where n:"n∈nat" "y1:succ(n)→Σ" unfolding NELists_def by auto
    have lastY:"Last(y1)∈Σ" using last_type[OF y(1)] by auto
    have initY:"Init(y1):n→Σ" using init_props(1)[OF n(1) n(2)] by auto
    have sing:"{⟨0,Last(y1)⟩}:1→Σ" using list_len1_singleton[OF lastY] by auto
    have y1eq:"y1 = Concat(Init(y1),{⟨0,Last(y1)⟩})"
    proof-
      have "y1 = Append(Init(y1), Last(y1))"
        using init_props(3)[OF n(1) n(2)] last_seq_elem[OF n(2)] by auto
      also have "Append(Init(y1), Last(y1)) = Concat(Init(y1), {⟨0,Last(y1)⟩})"
        using append_concat_pair[OF n(1) initY lastY] by auto
      finally show ?thesis .
    qed
    have assoc:"Concat(Concat(Init(y1),{⟨0,Last(y1)⟩}),j) =
        Concat(Init(y1),Concat({⟨0,Last(y1)⟩},j))"
      using concat_assoc[OF n(1) _ m(1) initY sing m(2)] by auto
    have jL:"Concat({⟨0,Last(y1)⟩},j)∈Lists(Σ)"
    proof-
      have "{⟨0,Last(y1)⟩}∈Lists(Σ)"
        using list_len1_singleton[OF lastY] one_is_nat unfolding Lists_def by auto
      then show ?thesis using concat_type[OF _ j(1)] by auto
    qed
    from j(2) y1eq assoc have "w = Concat(Init(y1), Concat({⟨0,Last(y1)⟩},j))" by auto
    with jL y(4) show "∃j'∈Lists(Σ). w = Concat(fst(z),j')" by auto
  qed
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹Once L1 is reached, the relation is equivalent to its DFSA›

text‹Step 1: We prove concat\_FSA\_apply\_L1\_step using the three sub-lemmas above.
Note: the statement requires an additional hypothesis that the prefix s is a list over ‹Σ›.›

lemma concat_FSA_apply_L1_step:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  defines "s⇩0 ≡ ⟨s01,0⟩"
  defines "F ≡ F2×{1}"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and j:"⟨⟨j,p⟩,⟨r,q⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)^*" "j≠0"
  and states:"⟨p,0⟩∈P" "P∈Pow(S)"
  and sL:"s∈Lists(Σ)"
  shows "∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨q,0⟩∈Q ∧ (⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,r),Q⟩⟩∈(({reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*))"
proof-
  let ?r="{reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ"
  from j(1) have "⟨j,p⟩∈field(({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)^*)" using fieldI1 by auto
  then have "⟨j,p⟩∈field({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)" using rtrancl_field by auto
  then have jl:"j∈Lists(Σ)" using DetFinStateAuto.reduce_field(1) A1 unfolding DetFinStateAuto_def
    using fin by blast
  have jne:"j∈NELists(Σ)" using non_zero_List_func_is_NEList j(2) jl by auto
  have Csj:"Concat(s,j)∈NELists(Σ)" using concat_is_NElist[OF sL jne] by auto
  have "∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨snd(⟨r,q⟩),0⟩∈Q ∧ ⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(⟨r,q⟩)),Q⟩⟩∈?r^*"
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct[OF j(1), where P="λv. ∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨snd(v),0⟩∈Q ∧ (⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(v)),Q⟩⟩∈(?r^*))"])
    from states(2) have "⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩∈field(?r)"
      using eps_nfsa_field(2)[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
      S_def t_def s⇩0_def Csj by auto
    then have "⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩⟩∈?r^*" using rtrancl_refl by auto
    with states show "∃Q∈Pow(S).
      ⟨snd(⟨j,p⟩),0⟩∈Q ∧
      ⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(⟨j,p⟩)),Q⟩⟩∈?r^*" by auto
  next
    fix y z assume as:"⟨⟨j,p⟩,y⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
      "⟨y,z⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)"
      "∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨snd(y),0⟩∈Q ∧ ⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(y)),Q⟩⟩∈?r^*"
    from as(2) obtain yl ys where yz:"yl∈NELists(Σ)" "ys∈S1" "y=⟨yl,ys⟩" "z=⟨Init(yl),t1`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩⟩"
      unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A1] by auto
    from yz(3) as(3) obtain Qy where Q:"Qy∈Pow(S)" "⟨ys,0⟩∈Qy" "⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,yl),Qy⟩⟩∈?r^*"
      by auto
    have Csyl:"Concat(s,yl)∈NELists(Σ)" using concat_is_NElist[OF sL yz(1)] by auto
    have lastEq:"Last(Concat(s,yl)) = Last(yl)" using concat_last_NElist[OF sL yz(1)] by auto
    have initEq:"Init(Concat(s,yl)) = Concat(s,Init(yl))" using concat_init_NElist[OF sL yz(1)] by auto
    have "⟨⟨Concat(s,yl),Qy⟩,Init(Concat(s,yl)),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(Concat(s,yl))⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})⟩∈?r"
      unfolding FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
          S_def t_def s⇩0_def using Csyl Q(1) S_def by auto
    with lastEq initEq
    have step:"⟨⟨Concat(s,yl),Qy⟩,Concat(s,Init(yl)),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})⟩∈?r"
      by auto
    with Q(3) have "⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,Init(yl)),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})⟩⟩∈?r^*"
      using rtrancl_into_rtrancl by auto
    with yz(4) have A:"⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(z)),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})⟩⟩∈?r^*"
      by auto
    from yz(1) have "Last(yl)∈Σ" using last_type by auto
    then have C1:"t`⟨⟨ys,0⟩,Last(yl)⟩={t1`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩}×{0}"
      using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp0'[OF fin A1 A2 yz(2)] unfolding t_def by auto
    have tT:"t:S×succ(Σ)→Pow(S)" using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]
      unfolding t_def FullNFSA_def[OF fin] s⇩0_def S_def by auto
    have unionS:"⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)}∈Pow(S)"
    proof
      { fix x assume "x∈⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)}"
        then obtain ss where ss:"ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)" "x∈t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩" by auto
        from Q(1) ss(1) have ssS:"ss∈S" using S_def t_def
          EpsilonClosure_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]] by auto
        have lastSig:"Last(yl)∈succ(Σ)" using last_type[OF yz(1)] by auto
        have "⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩∈S×succ(Σ)" using ssS lastSig by auto
        from apply_type[OF tT this] ss(2) have "x∈S" by auto }
      then show "(⋃ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy). t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩) ⊆ S" by auto
    qed
    then have B:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})∈Pow(S)"
      using EpsilonClosure_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]] S_def t_def by auto
    have "Qy ⊆ ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)" using epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
      using Q(1) S_def t_def by auto
    with Q(2) have sub:"t`⟨⟨ys,0⟩,Last(yl)⟩⊆⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)}" by auto
    with unionS have C2:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,t`⟨⟨ys,0⟩,Last(yl)⟩)⊆ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})"
      using epsilon_cl_mono[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]] unfolding S_def t_def by auto
    from unionS sub have "t`⟨⟨ys,0⟩,Last(yl)⟩⊆S" by auto
    then have "t`⟨⟨ys,0⟩,Last(yl)⟩⊆ε-cl(S,t,Σ,t`⟨⟨ys,0⟩,Last(yl)⟩)"
      using epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
      unfolding S_def t_def by auto
    with C1 C2 have C:"⟨t1`⟨ys,Last(yl)⟩,0⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Qy)})" by auto
    from A B C yz(4) show "∃Q∈Pow(S). ⟨snd(z),0⟩∈Q ∧ ⟨⟨Concat(s,j),P⟩,⟨Concat(s,fst(z)),Q⟩⟩∈?r^*"
      by auto
  qed
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹Once the only thing left is a word in L1, it passes if s01 is one of the initial
states.›

lemma concat_FSA_apply_L1:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  defines "s⇩0 ≡ ⟨s01,0⟩"
  defines "F ≡ F2×{1}"
  defines "L1 ≡ {i∈Lists(Σ). i <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ}"
  defines "L2 ≡ {i∈Lists(Σ). i <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ}"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and j:"j∈L1" "⟨s01,0⟩∈Q" "Q∈Pow(S)" "j≠0"
  and k:"u∈Lists(Σ)"
  shows "∃q∈Pow(S). ⟨s02,1⟩∈q ∧ (⟨⟨Concat(u,j),Q⟩,⟨u,q⟩⟩∈(({reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*))"
proof-
  let ?r="({reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)"
  from j(1) have jj:"j∈Lists(Σ)" "j <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ"
    unfolding L1_def by auto
  from jj(2) j(4) obtain q where q:"q∈F1" "⟨⟨j,s01⟩,⟨0,q⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)^*"
    unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A1 jj(1)] by auto
  then obtain K where k_def:"K∈Pow(S)" "⟨q,0⟩∈K" "⟨⟨Concat(u,j),Q⟩,⟨Concat(u,0),K⟩⟩∈(({reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)"
    using concat_FSA_apply_L1_step[OF fin A1 A2 q(2) j(4,2), of u] j(3) k unfolding S_def t_def s⇩0_def L2_def by auto
  have u:"Concat(u,0) = u" using k concat_empty unfolding Lists_def by auto
  {
    assume "⟨⟨Concat(u,j),Q⟩,⟨Concat(u,0),K⟩⟩∈id(field(?r))"
    then have "Concat(u,j) = u" using u by auto moreover
    from k obtain n where u:"n∈nat" "u:n→Σ" unfolding L2_def Lists_def by auto
    ultimately have "domain(Concat(u,j)) = n" using func1_1_L1 by auto
    moreover from jj(1) j(4) have "j:NELists(Σ)" using non_zero_List_func_is_NEList
      by auto
    then obtain k where jk:"k∈nat" "j:succ(k)→Σ" unfolding NELists_def by auto
    from jk(2) u(2) have "Concat(u,j):n#+succ(k)→Σ" using concat_props(1)[OF u(1) nat_succI[OF jk(1)]] by auto
    then have "domain(Concat(u,j)) = n#+succ(k)" using func1_1_L1 by auto
    ultimately have "n=n#+succ(k)" by blast
    then have "n#+0=n#+succ(k)" using add_0_right[OF u(1)] trans[of "n#+0" n "n#+succ(k)"] 
      by blast
    then have "0=succ(k)" using add_left_cancel[OF _ _ _ nat_succI[OF jk(1)], of n n 0] by auto
    then have False by auto
  } moreover
  {
    assume "⟨⟨Concat(u,j),Q⟩,⟨Concat(u,0),K⟩⟩∉id(field(?r))"
    moreover have "⟨⟨Concat(u,j),Q⟩,⟨Concat(u,0),K⟩⟩∈id(field(?r))∪(?r O ?r^*)"
      using k_def(3) rtrancl_unfold by auto
    ultimately have "⟨⟨Concat(u,j),Q⟩,⟨Concat(u,0),K⟩⟩∈(?r O ?r^*)" by auto
    then obtain P where P:"⟨⟨Concat(u,j),Q⟩,P⟩∈?r^*" "⟨P,⟨Concat(u,0),K⟩⟩∈?r" using compE by auto
    from P(2) have A:"K=ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨s,Last(fst(P))⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,snd(P))})" "fst(P)∈NELists(Σ)"
      "snd(P)∈Pow(S)" using FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
      S_def t_def s⇩0_def by auto
    {
      fix w σ assume as:"w∈Pow(S)" "σ∈Σ"
      have type:"t:S×succ(Σ)→Pow(S)" using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]
          using FullNFSA_def[OF fin] S_def t_def by auto
      have s:"σ∈succ(Σ)" using as(2) by auto
      {
        fix m assume "m∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,w)"
        then have "m∈S" using as(1) EpsilonClosure_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
          S_def t_def by auto
        with s have "t`⟨m,σ⟩∈Pow(S)" using apply_type[OF type] by auto
      }
      then have "⋃{t`⟨m,σ⟩. m∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,w)} ∈Pow(S)" by auto
    }
    moreover from A(2) have "Last(fst(P)):Σ" using last_type by auto
    moreover note A(3) ultimately
    have "⋃{t`⟨s,Last(fst(P))⟩. s∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,snd(P))}∈Pow(S)" by auto
    with A(1) have A:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,K) = K" using epsilon_cl_idem[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
      S_def t_def s⇩0_def k_def(1) by auto
    have "⟨s02,1⟩∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,K)" using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2]
      k_def(1,2) q(1) unfolding S_def t_def by auto
    with A have "⟨s02,1⟩∈K" by auto
  }
  ultimately have "⟨s02,1⟩∈K" by auto
  with k_def(1,3) u show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹The $\varepsilon$-closure of a set of side-1 states stays within side 1:
for $T \subseteq S_2$ we have $\varepsilon$-cl$(S,t,\Sigma,T\times\{1\}) = T\times\{1\}$.
This holds because the $\varepsilon$-transition from every side-1 state is empty
(by ‹concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1›), so the closure adds nothing.›

lemma epsilon_cl_side1:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and sig:"T⊆S2"
  shows "ε-cl(S,t,Σ,T×{1}) = T×{1}"
proof-
  have TS:"T×{1}∈Pow(concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2))"
    using sig unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have eq:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,T×{1}) = T×{1} ∪ {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. (T×{1})∩(F1×1)≠0}"
    using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2 TS] unfolding S_def t_def by auto
  have "(T×{1})∩(F1×1) = 0" by auto
  with eq show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹One letter step in the concat $\varepsilon$-NFSA, starting from a state set
of the form $\{\langle q_1,0\rangle\} \cup Q_2\times\{1\}$, produces a state set of the
same form, with the side-0 singleton updated by the DFA transition of $A_1$.›

lemma exec_step_form:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ q1 Q2 ltr
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and q1S1:"q1∈S1" and Q2S2:"Q2⊆S2" and ltrS:"ltr∈Σ"
  shows "∃Q2n∈Pow(S2). ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,ltr⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1})})
                  = {⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩} ∪ Q2n×{1}"
proof-
  have t1T:"t1:S1×Σ→S1" using A1 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have t2T:"t2:S2×Σ→S2" using A2 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have s02S2:"s02∈S2" using A2 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have q1'S1:"t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩∈S1" using apply_type[OF t1T] q1S1 ltrS by auto
  have RS:"{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}∈Pow(concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2))"
    using q1S1 Q2S2 unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  ― ‹epsilon-closure of the starting set›
  have ecl:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}) =
    {⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q1∈F1}"
  proof-
    have eq:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}) =
      ({⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}) ∪ {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. ({⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1})∩(F1×1)≠0}"
      using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2 RS] unfolding S_def t_def by auto
    have "({⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1})∩(F1×1) = {x∈{⟨q1,0⟩}. q1∈F1}"
      by auto
    with eq show ?thesis by auto
  qed
  ― ‹union of t-images over the epsilon-closure›
  let ?cl = "{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q1∈F1}"
  let ?U = "⋃{t`⟨ss,ltr⟩. ss∈?cl}"
  have step0:"t`⟨⟨q1,0⟩,ltr⟩ = {t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩}×{0}"
    using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp0'[OF fin A1 A2 q1S1 ltrS] unfolding t_def by auto
  have stepR:"⋀r. r∈Q2 ⟹ t`⟨⟨r,1⟩,ltr⟩ = {t2`⟨r,ltr⟩}×{1}"
    using Q2S2 ltrS concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1'[OF fin A1 A2 _ ltrS] unfolding t_def by auto
  have stepS02:"t`⟨⟨s02,1⟩,ltr⟩ = {t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}×{1}"
    using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1'[OF fin A1 A2 s02S2 ltrS] unfolding t_def by auto
  have Uform:"?U = {⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩} ∪
    ({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2} ∪ {x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1}"
  proof(rule equalityI)
    { 
      fix x assume "x∈?U"
      then obtain ss where ss:"ss∈?cl" "x∈t`⟨ss,ltr⟩" by auto
      from ss(1) have "ss=⟨q1,0⟩ ∨ (∃r∈Q2. ss=⟨r,1⟩) ∨ (q1∈F1 ∧ ss=⟨s02,1⟩)" by blast
      moreover { assume "ss=⟨q1,0⟩"
        with ss(2) step0 have "x=⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩" by auto
        then have "x∈{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}" by auto }
      moreover { assume "∃r∈Q2. ss=⟨r,1⟩"
        then obtain r where r:"r∈Q2" "ss=⟨r,1⟩" by auto
        with ss(2) stepR[OF r(1)] have "x=⟨t2`⟨r,ltr⟩,1⟩" by auto
        with r(1) have "x∈{t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}×{1}" by auto }
      moreover { assume "q1∈F1 ∧ ss=⟨s02,1⟩"
        with ss(2) stepS02 have "x=⟨t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩,1⟩" by auto
        then have "x∈{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1}×{1}"
          using ‹q1∈F1 ∧ ss=⟨s02,1⟩› by auto }
      ultimately have "x∈{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}∪({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1}"
        by auto 
    }
    then show "?U ⊆ {⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}∪({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1}" by blast
    { fix x assume
        "x∈{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}∪({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1}"
      then have "x=⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩ ∨
        (∃r∈Q2. x=⟨t2`⟨r,ltr⟩,1⟩) ∨ (q1∈F1 ∧ x=⟨t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩,1⟩)" by blast
      moreover { assume "x=⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩"
        then have "x∈t`⟨⟨q1,0⟩,ltr⟩" using step0 by auto
        then have "x∈?U" by auto }
      moreover { assume "∃r∈Q2. x=⟨t2`⟨r,ltr⟩,1⟩"
        then obtain r where r:"r∈Q2" "x=⟨t2`⟨r,ltr⟩,1⟩" by auto
        then have "x∈t`⟨⟨r,1⟩,ltr⟩" using stepR[OF r(1)] by auto
        with r(1) have "x∈?U" by auto }
      moreover { assume "q1∈F1 ∧ x=⟨t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩,1⟩"
        then have "x∈t`⟨⟨s02,1⟩,ltr⟩" using stepS02 by auto
        then have "x∈?U" using ‹q1∈F1 ∧ x=_› by auto }
      ultimately have "x∈?U" by blast }
    then show "{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}∪({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1} ⊆ ?U"
      by blast
  qed
  (* Q2_mid ⊆ S2*)
  let ?Q2mid = "{t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1}"
  have Q2midS2:"?Q2mid ⊆ S2"
  proof
    fix x assume "x∈?Q2mid"
    then have "(∃r∈Q2. x=t2`⟨r,ltr⟩) ∨ (q1∈F1 ∧ x=t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩)" by blast
    moreover { assume "∃r∈Q2. x=t2`⟨r,ltr⟩"
      then obtain r where r:"r∈Q2" "x=t2`⟨r,ltr⟩" by auto
      from Q2S2 r(1) have "r∈S2" by auto
      with ltrS have "t2`⟨r,ltr⟩∈S2" using apply_type[OF t2T] by auto
      with r(2) have "x∈S2" by auto }
    moreover { assume "q1∈F1 ∧ x=t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩"
      with ltrS have "t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩∈S2" using apply_type[OF t2T] s02S2 by auto
      then have "x∈S2" using ‹q1∈F1 ∧ x=_› by auto }
    ultimately show "x∈S2" by auto
  qed
  (* U ∈ Pow(S): needed for the second epsilon-closure*)
  have US:"?U∈Pow(concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2))"
    using q1'S1 Q2midS2
    unfolding Uform concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  (* second epsilon-closure*)
  have ecl2:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,?U) = ?U ∪ {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. ?U∩(F1×1)≠0}"
    using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2 US] unfolding S_def t_def by auto
  have Uint:"?U∩(F1×1) = {x∈{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}. t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩∈F1}"
    unfolding Uform by auto
  have "ε-cl(S,t,Σ,?U) = {⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩} ∪
    (?Q2mid ∪ {x∈{s02}. t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩∈F1})×{1}"
    using ecl2 Uint Uform by auto
  moreover have "?Q2mid ∪ {x∈{s02}. t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩∈F1} ⊆ S2"
    using Q2midS2 s02S2 by auto
  ultimately show ?thesis
    using ecl
    by (intro bexI[of _ "?Q2mid∪{x∈{s02}. t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩∈F1}" "Pow(S2)"]) auto
qed

text‹Explicit form of the next state set after one step of the concat ‹ε›-NFSA.›

lemma exec_step_Q2_form:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ q1 Q2 ltr
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and q1S1:"q1∈S1" and Q2S2:"Q2⊆S2" and ltrS:"ltr∈Σ"
  shows "ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,ltr⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1})})
       = {⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩} ∪
         ({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2} ∪ {x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1} ∪
          {x∈{s02}. t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩∈F1})×{1}"
proof-
  have t1T:"t1:S1×Σ→S1" using A1 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have t2T:"t2:S2×Σ→S2" using A2 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have s02S2:"s02∈S2" using A2 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have q1'S1:"t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩∈S1" using apply_type[OF t1T] q1S1 ltrS by auto
  have RS:"{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}∈Pow(concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2))"
    using q1S1 Q2S2 unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  have ecl:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}) =
    {⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q1∈F1}"
  proof-
    have eq:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}) =
      ({⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}) ∪ {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. ({⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1})∩(F1×1)≠0}"
      using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2 RS] unfolding S_def t_def by auto
    have "({⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1})∩(F1×1) = {x∈{⟨q1,0⟩}. q1∈F1}"
      by auto
    with eq show ?thesis by auto
  qed
  let ?cl = "{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q1∈F1}"
  let ?U = "⋃{t`⟨ss,ltr⟩. ss∈?cl}"
  have step0:"t`⟨⟨q1,0⟩,ltr⟩ = {t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩}×{0}"
    using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp0'[OF fin A1 A2 q1S1 ltrS] unfolding t_def by auto
  have stepR:"⋀r. r∈Q2 ⟹ t`⟨⟨r,1⟩,ltr⟩ = {t2`⟨r,ltr⟩}×{1}"
    using Q2S2 ltrS concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1'[OF fin A1 A2 _ ltrS] unfolding t_def by auto
  have stepS02:"t`⟨⟨s02,1⟩,ltr⟩ = {t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}×{1}"
    using concat_eNFSA_eps_comp1'[OF fin A1 A2 s02S2 ltrS] unfolding t_def by auto
  have Uform:"?U = {⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩} ∪
    ({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2} ∪ {x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1}"
  proof(rule equalityI)
    { fix x assume "x∈?U"
      then obtain ss where ss:"ss∈?cl" "x∈t`⟨ss,ltr⟩" by auto
      from ss(1) have "ss=⟨q1,0⟩ ∨ (∃r∈Q2. ss=⟨r,1⟩) ∨ (q1∈F1 ∧ ss=⟨s02,1⟩)" by blast
      moreover { assume "ss=⟨q1,0⟩"
        with ss(2) step0 have "x=⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩" by auto
        then have "x∈{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}" by auto }
      moreover { assume "∃r∈Q2. ss=⟨r,1⟩"
        then obtain r where r:"r∈Q2" "ss=⟨r,1⟩" by auto
        with ss(2) stepR[OF r(1)] have "x=⟨t2`⟨r,ltr⟩,1⟩" by auto
        with r(1) have "x∈{t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}×{1}" by auto }
      moreover { assume "q1∈F1 ∧ ss=⟨s02,1⟩"
        with ss(2) stepS02 have "x=⟨t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩,1⟩" by auto
        then have "x∈{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1}×{1}"
          using ‹q1∈F1 ∧ ss=⟨s02,1⟩› by auto }
      ultimately have "x∈{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}∪({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1}"
        by auto }
    then show "?U ⊆ {⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}∪({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1}" by blast
    { fix x assume
        "x∈{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}∪({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1}"
      then have "x=⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩ ∨
        (∃r∈Q2. x=⟨t2`⟨r,ltr⟩,1⟩) ∨ (q1∈F1 ∧ x=⟨t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩,1⟩)" by blast
      moreover { assume "x=⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩"
        then have "x∈t`⟨⟨q1,0⟩,ltr⟩" using step0 by auto
        then have "x∈?U" by auto }
      moreover { assume "∃r∈Q2. x=⟨t2`⟨r,ltr⟩,1⟩"
        then obtain r where r:"r∈Q2" "x=⟨t2`⟨r,ltr⟩,1⟩" by auto
        then have "x∈t`⟨⟨r,1⟩,ltr⟩" using stepR[OF r(1)] by auto
        with r(1) have "x∈?U" by auto }
      moreover { assume "q1∈F1 ∧ x=⟨t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩,1⟩"
        then have "x∈t`⟨⟨s02,1⟩,ltr⟩" using stepS02 by auto
        then have "x∈?U" using ‹q1∈F1 ∧ x=_› by auto }
      ultimately have "x∈?U" by blast }
    then show "{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}∪({t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1})×{1} ⊆ ?U"
      by blast
  qed
  let ?Q2mid = "{t2`⟨r,ltr⟩. r∈Q2}∪{x∈{t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩}. q1∈F1}"
  have US:"?U∈Pow(concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2))"
  proof-
    have Q2midS2:"?Q2mid ⊆ S2"
    proof
      fix x assume "x∈?Q2mid"
      then have "(∃r∈Q2. x=t2`⟨r,ltr⟩) ∨ (q1∈F1 ∧ x=t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩)" by blast
      moreover { assume "∃r∈Q2. x=t2`⟨r,ltr⟩"
        then obtain r where r:"r∈Q2" "x=t2`⟨r,ltr⟩" by auto
        from Q2S2 r(1) have "r∈S2" by auto
        with ltrS have "t2`⟨r,ltr⟩∈S2" using apply_type[OF t2T] by auto
        with r(2) have "x∈S2" by auto }
      moreover { assume "q1∈F1 ∧ x=t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩"
        with ltrS have "t2`⟨s02,ltr⟩∈S2" using apply_type[OF t2T] s02S2 by auto
        then have "x∈S2" using ‹q1∈F1 ∧ x=_› by auto }
      ultimately show "x∈S2" by auto
    qed
    show ?thesis using q1'S1 Q2midS2 unfolding Uform concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
  qed
  have ecl2:"ε-cl(S,t,Σ,?U) = ?U ∪ {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. ?U∩(F1×1)≠0}"
    using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2 US] unfolding S_def t_def by auto
  have Uint:"?U∩(F1×1) = {x∈{⟨t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩,0⟩}. t1`⟨q1,ltr⟩∈F1}"
    unfolding Uform by auto
  show ?thesis using ecl ecl2 Uint Uform by auto
qed

text‹If the concat $\varepsilon$-NFSA executes word $w$ (non-empty) from $\{\langle s_{01},0\rangle\}$
and reaches $\langle v,Q\rangle$, then $Q$ has the form $\{\langle q_1,0\rangle\}\cup Q_2\times\{1\}$
with $q_1\in S_1$, $Q_2\subseteq S_2$, and $A_1$ tracks the word: $\langle\langle w,s_{01}\rangle,\langle v,q_1\rangle\rangle\in r_{D_1}^*$.›

lemma exec_state_form:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ w v Q
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and wNE:"w∈NELists(Σ)"
  and run:"⟨⟨w,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩,⟨v,Q⟩⟩ ∈ (({reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)"
  shows "∃q1∈S1. ∃Q2∈Pow(S2). Q = {⟨q1,0⟩} ∪ Q2×{1} ∧
         ⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨v,q1⟩⟩∈(({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)^*)"
proof-
  let ?r  = "{reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ"
  let ?rD = "{reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ"
  have fsa:"(S,⟨s01,0⟩,t,F2×{1}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] unfolding S_def t_def by auto
  have s01S1:"s01∈S1" using A1 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have wfield:"⟨w,s01⟩∈field(?rD)"
    using wNE s01S1 DetFinStateAuto.reduce_field(2)
    unfolding DetFinStateAuto_def using A1 fin by blast
  let ?P = "λuR. ∃q1∈S1. ∃Q2∈Pow(S2). snd(uR) = {⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1} ∧
              ⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨fst(uR),q1⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
  have "?P(⟨v,Q⟩)"
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct[of "⟨w,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩" "⟨v,Q⟩" ?r ?P])
    show "⟨⟨w,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩,⟨v,Q⟩⟩∈?r^*" using run .
    ― ‹base case: initial state set ‹{⟨s01,0⟩}› has the form with q1=s01, ‹Q2=∅››
    show "?P(⟨w,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩)"
      using rtrancl_refl[OF wfield] s01S1 by auto
  next
    fix y z
    assume IH_run:"⟨⟨w,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩,y⟩∈?r^*"
      and step:"⟨y,z⟩∈?r"
      and IH:"?P(y)"
    ― ‹unpack the ‹ε›-NFSA step: first rewrite the hypothesis, then extract›
    from step have step_unf:"⟨y,z⟩∈{⟨⟨w,Q⟩,⟨Init(w),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(w)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Q)})⟩⟩. ⟨w,Q⟩∈NELists(Σ)×Pow(S)}"
      unfolding FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin fsa] by simp
    from step_unf obtain yl R where yz:
      "yl∈NELists(Σ)" "R∈Pow(S)"
      "y=⟨yl,R⟩"
      "z=⟨Init(yl),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,R)})⟩"
      by auto
    ― ‹unpack the inductive hypothesis›
    from IH yz(3) obtain q1 Q2 where IHd:
      "q1∈S1" "Q2∈Pow(S2)" "R={⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}"
      "⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨yl,q1⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
      by auto
    have Q2S2:"Q2⊆S2" using IHd(2) by auto
    have aS:"Last(yl)∈Σ" using last_type[OF yz(1)] .
    ― ‹apply ‹exec_step_form› to get the new structured state›
    from exec_step_form[OF fin A1 A2 IHd(1) Q2S2 aS]
    obtain Q2n where Q2n:"Q2n∈Pow(S2)"
      "ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1})})
       = {⟨t1`⟨q1,Last(yl)⟩,0⟩}∪Q2n×{1}"
      unfolding S_def t_def by auto
    have zform:"z=⟨Init(yl),{⟨t1`⟨q1,Last(yl)⟩,0⟩}∪Q2n×{1}⟩"
      using yz(4) Q2n(2) IHd(3) by auto
    ― ‹DFA tracking: one more step of A1›
    have t1S1:"t1`⟨q1,Last(yl)⟩∈S1"
      using A1 IHd(1) aS unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by (auto intro: apply_type)
    have dfaStep:"⟨⟨yl,q1⟩,⟨Init(yl),t1`⟨q1,Last(yl)⟩⟩⟩∈?rD"
      unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A1] using yz(1) IHd(1) by auto
    have newDfa:"⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨Init(yl),t1`⟨q1,Last(yl)⟩⟩⟩∈?rD^*"
      using rtrancl_into_rtrancl[OF IHd(4) dfaStep] .
    ― ‹conclude: P(z) holds with ‹q1_next=t1`⟨q1,Last(yl)⟩› and Q2n›
    show "?P(z)" using zform t1S1 Q2n(1) newDfa by auto
  qed
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹For each component-2 state ‹q2› that appears in the state set reached by
the concat ‹ε›-NFSA after reading non-empty word ‹w›, either (a) there is a
non-empty suffix ‹yl_k› of ‹w› such that A1 ran from ‹s01› to some ‹f1∈F1›
while consuming the complementary prefix, and A2 then ran from ‹s02› to ‹q2›
while consuming ‹yl_k›; or (b) ‹q2 = s02› and the ‹ε›-jump into A2 happened
only at the very end, so A1 reached some ‹f1∈F1› after consuming all of ‹w›.›

lemma exec_A2_component:
  fixes S1 S2 s01 s02 t1 t2 F1 F2 Σ w v q1 Q2 q2
  defines "t ≡ concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  defines "S ≡ concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and wNE:"w∈NELists(Σ)"
  and run:"⟨⟨w,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩,⟨v,{⟨q1,0⟩} ∪ Q2×{1}⟩⟩
             ∈ (({reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)"
  and q1S1:"q1∈S1"
  and Q2S2:"Q2∈Pow(S2)"
  and q2Q2:"q2∈Q2"
  shows "(∃yl_k∈NELists(Σ). ∃f1∈F1.
            ⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨yl_k,f1⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)^* ∧
            ⟨⟨yl_k,s02⟩,⟨v,q2⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)^*)
         ∨
         (q2 = s02 ∧ (∃f1∈F1.
            ⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨v,f1⟩⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)^*))"
proof-
  let ?rε = "{reduce ε-N-relation}(S,t){in alphabet}Σ"
  let ?rD1 = "{reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ"
  let ?rD2 = "{reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ"
  have s01S1:"s01∈S1" using A1 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have s02S2:"s02∈S2" using A2 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have t1T:"t1:S1×Σ→S1" using A1 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have t2T:"t2:S2×Σ→S2" using A2 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  have fsa:"(S,⟨s01,0⟩,t,F2×{1}){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] unfolding S_def t_def by auto
  have wfieldD1:"⟨w,s01⟩∈field(?rD1)"
    using wNE s01S1 DetFinStateAuto.reduce_field(2)
    unfolding DetFinStateAuto_def using A1 fin by blast
  ― ‹Enriched predicate: tracks A1 state and for every A2 state records ‹case_a/case_b›.›
  let ?case_a = "λq2' v'. ∃yl_k∈NELists(Σ). ∃f1∈F1.
      ⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨yl_k,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^* ∧ ⟨⟨yl_k,s02⟩,⟨v',q2'⟩⟩∈?rD2^*"
  let ?case_b = "λq2' v'. q2'=s02 ∧ (∃f1∈F1. ⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨v',f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*)"
  let ?P = "λuR. ∃q1'∈S1. ∃Q2'∈Pow(S2). snd(uR) = {⟨q1',0⟩}∪Q2'×{1} ∧
      ⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨fst(uR),q1'⟩⟩∈?rD1^* ∧
      (∀q2'∈Q2'. ?case_a(q2', fst(uR)) ∨ ?case_b(q2', fst(uR)))"
  have Pmain:"?P(⟨v, {⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}⟩)"
  proof(rule rtrancl_induct[of "⟨w,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩" "⟨v,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}⟩" ?rε ?P])
    show "⟨⟨w,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩,⟨v,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}⟩⟩∈?rε^*" using run .
    ― ‹Base: Q2'=‹∅›, vacuous ‹∀›.›
    show "?P(⟨w,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩)"
      using rtrancl_refl[OF wfieldD1] s01S1 by auto
  next
    fix y z
    assume step:"⟨y,z⟩∈?rε"
    assume IH:"?P(y)"
    ― ‹Unpack the ‹ε›-NFSA step.›
    from step have step_unf:
      "⟨y,z⟩∈{⟨⟨w,Q⟩,⟨Init(w),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(w)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,Q)})⟩⟩.
        ⟨w,Q⟩∈NELists(Σ)×Pow(S)}"
      unfolding FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin fsa] by simp
    from step_unf obtain yl R where yz:
      "yl∈NELists(Σ)" "R∈Pow(S)" "y=⟨yl,R⟩"
      "z=⟨Init(yl),ε-cl(S,t,Σ,⋃{t`⟨ss,Last(yl)⟩. ss∈ε-cl(S,t,Σ,R)})⟩"
      by auto
    ― ‹Unpack the inductive hypothesis.›
    from IH yz(3) obtain q1ih Q2ih where IHd:
      "q1ih∈S1" "Q2ih∈Pow(S2)" "R={⟨q1ih,0⟩}∪Q2ih×{1}"
      "⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨yl,q1ih⟩⟩∈?rD1^*"
      "∀q2'∈Q2ih. ?case_a(q2', yl) ∨ ?case_b(q2', yl)"
      by auto
    have Q2ihS2:"Q2ih⊆S2" using IHd(2) by auto
    have ltrS:"Last(yl)∈Σ" using last_type[OF yz(1)] .
    ― ‹Name the letter and the new A1 state.›
    let ?ltr = "Last(yl)"
    let ?q1' = "t1`⟨q1ih,?ltr⟩"
    ― ‹Explicit Q2n via ‹exec_step_Q2_form›.›
    let ?Q2n = "{t2`⟨r,?ltr⟩. r∈Q2ih} ∪ {x∈{t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩}. q1ih∈F1} ∪
               {x∈{s02}. ?q1'∈F1}"
    have zform:"z=⟨Init(yl),{⟨?q1',0⟩}∪?Q2n×{1}⟩"
      using exec_step_Q2_form[OF fin A1 A2 IHd(1) Q2ihS2 ltrS] yz(4) IHd(3)
      unfolding S_def t_def by auto
    have q1'S1:"?q1'∈S1" using apply_type[OF t1T] IHd(1) ltrS by auto
    have Q2nS2:"?Q2n∈Pow(S2)"
    proof-
      { fix x assume "x∈?Q2n"
        then have "(∃r∈Q2ih. x=t2`⟨r,?ltr⟩) ∨ (q1ih∈F1 ∧ x=t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩) ∨
            (?q1'∈F1 ∧ x=s02)" by blast
        moreover { assume "∃r∈Q2ih. x=t2`⟨r,?ltr⟩"
          then obtain r where r:"r∈Q2ih" "x=t2`⟨r,?ltr⟩" by auto
          from Q2ihS2 r(1) have "r∈S2" by auto
          with ltrS have "x∈S2" using r(2) apply_type[OF t2T] by auto }
        moreover { assume "q1ih∈F1 ∧ x=t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩"
          with ltrS s02S2 have "x∈S2" using apply_type[OF t2T] by auto }
        moreover { assume "?q1'∈F1 ∧ x=s02"
          with s02S2 have "x∈S2" by auto }
        ultimately have "x∈S2" by auto }
      then show ?thesis by auto
    qed
    ― ‹Extend the A1 DFA tracking by one step.›
    have dfaStep1:"⟨⟨yl,q1ih⟩,⟨Init(yl),?q1'⟩⟩∈?rD1"
      unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A1] using yz(1) IHd(1) by auto
    have newDfa1:"⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨Init(yl),?q1'⟩⟩∈?rD1^*"
      using rtrancl_into_rtrancl[OF IHd(4) dfaStep1] .
    ― ‹For every ‹q2'∈Q2n› prove ‹case_a› or ‹case_b›.›
    have allQ2n:"∀q2'∈?Q2n. ?case_a(q2', Init(yl)) ∨ ?case_b(q2', Init(yl))"
    proof
      fix q2' assume q2'Q2n:"q2'∈?Q2n"
      from q2'Q2n have cases:"(∃r∈Q2ih. q2'=t2`⟨r,?ltr⟩) ∨
          (q1ih∈F1 ∧ q2'=t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩) ∨ (?q1'∈F1 ∧ q2'=s02)"
        by blast
      moreover
      { ― ‹Case: ‹q2'=t2(r,ltr)› for some ‹r∈Q2ih›.›
        assume "∃r∈Q2ih. q2'=t2`⟨r,?ltr⟩"
        then obtain r where r:"r∈Q2ih" "q2'=t2`⟨r,?ltr⟩" by auto
        from Q2ihS2 r(1) have rS2:"r∈S2" by auto
        from IHd(5) r(1) have IHr:"?case_a(r, yl) ∨ ?case_b(r, yl)" by auto
        moreover
        { assume ca:"?case_a(r, yl)"
          then obtain yk f1 where yk:
            "yk∈NELists(Σ)" "f1∈F1"
            "⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨yk,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*"
            "⟨⟨yk,s02⟩,⟨yl,r⟩⟩∈?rD2^*" by auto
          have step2:"⟨⟨yl,r⟩,⟨Init(yl),t2`⟨r,?ltr⟩⟩⟩∈?rD2"
            unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A2] using yz(1) rS2 by auto
          have nd2:"⟨⟨yk,s02⟩,⟨Init(yl),t2`⟨r,?ltr⟩⟩⟩∈?rD2^*"
            using rtrancl_into_rtrancl[OF yk(4) step2] .
          have "?case_a(q2', Init(yl))"
            using yk(1,2,3) nd2 r(2) by auto }
        moreover
        { assume cb:"?case_b(r, yl)"
          then have rs02:"r=s02" and "∃f1∈F1. ⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨yl,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*" by auto
          then obtain f1H where f1H:"f1H∈F1" "⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨yl,f1H⟩⟩∈?rD1^*" by auto
          have step2:"⟨⟨yl,s02⟩,⟨Init(yl),t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩⟩⟩∈?rD2"
            unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A2] using yz(1) s02S2 by auto
          have nd2:"⟨⟨yl,s02⟩,⟨Init(yl),t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩⟩⟩∈?rD2^*"
            using r_into_rtrancl step2 by auto
          have "?case_a(q2', Init(yl))"
            using yz(1) f1H(1,2) nd2 r(2) rs02 by auto }
        ultimately have "?case_a(q2', Init(yl)) ∨ ?case_b(q2', Init(yl))" by auto }
      moreover
      { ― ‹Case: ‹q1ih∈F1› so A2 enters via ‹ε›-jump and takes one step.›
        assume "q1ih∈F1 ∧ q2'=t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩"
        then have q1ihF1:"q1ih∈F1" and q2form:"q2'=t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩" by auto
        have step2:"⟨⟨yl,s02⟩,⟨Init(yl),t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩⟩⟩∈?rD2"
          unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A2] using yz(1) s02S2 by auto
        have nd2:"⟨⟨yl,s02⟩,⟨Init(yl),t2`⟨s02,?ltr⟩⟩⟩∈?rD2^*"
          using r_into_rtrancl step2 by auto
        have "?case_a(q2', Init(yl))"
          using yz(1) q1ihF1 IHd(4) nd2 q2form by auto }
      moreover
      { ― ‹Case: ‹q1'∈F1› so A2 enters at ‹s02› after this step.›
        assume "?q1'∈F1 ∧ q2'=s02"
        then have "?case_b(q2', Init(yl))"
          using newDfa1 by auto }
      ultimately show "?case_a(q2', Init(yl)) ∨ ?case_b(q2', Init(yl))" by auto
    qed
    ― ‹Assemble ‹?P(z)›: simplify ‹fst›/‹snd› first, then introduce witnesses.›
    show "?P(z)"
    proof-
      from zform have fstZ:"fst(z) = Init(yl)"
        and sndZ:"snd(z) = {⟨?q1',0⟩}∪?Q2n×{1}" by auto
      have nd1:"⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨fst(z),?q1'⟩⟩∈?rD1^*" using fstZ newDfa1 by auto
      have allz:"∀q2''∈?Q2n. ?case_a(q2'', fst(z)) ∨ ?case_b(q2'', fst(z))"
        using fstZ allQ2n by auto
      have "∃q1''∈S1. ∃Q2''∈Pow(S2). snd(z) = {⟨q1'',0⟩}∪Q2''×{1} ∧
            ⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨fst(z),q1''⟩⟩∈?rD1^* ∧
            (∀q2''∈Q2''. ?case_a(q2'', fst(z)) ∨ ?case_b(q2'', fst(z)))"
        using q1'S1 Q2nS2 sndZ nd1 allz
        by (intro bexI[of _ ?q1' S1] bexI[of _ ?Q2n "Pow(S2)"]) auto
      then show ?thesis by auto
    qed
  qed
  ― ‹Extract conclusion from ‹Pmain›.›
  from Pmain obtain q1p Q2p where Pd:
    "q1p∈S1" "Q2p∈Pow(S2)"
    "{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1} = {⟨q1p,0⟩}∪Q2p×{1}"
    "⟨⟨w,s01⟩,⟨v,q1p⟩⟩∈?rD1^*"
    "∀q2'∈Q2p. ?case_a(q2', v) ∨ ?case_b(q2', v)"
    by auto
  have q2Q2p:"q2∈Q2p"
  proof-
    have "⟨q2,1⟩∈Q2×{1}" using q2Q2 by auto
    then have "⟨q2,1⟩∈{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}" by auto
    with Pd(3) have "⟨q2,1⟩∈{⟨q1p,0⟩}∪Q2p×{1}" by auto
    then show "q2∈Q2p" by auto
  qed
  from Pd(5) q2Q2p show ?thesis by auto
qed

text‹The language of the product ‹ε›-NFSA equals the concatenation
of the two component languages.›

lemma concat_eNFSA_language:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
  and L1_def:"L1 = {i∈Lists(Σ). i <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ}"
  and L2_def:"L2 = {i∈Lists(Σ). i <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ}"
  shows "{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2),
             ⟨s01,0⟩,
             concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ),
             F2×{1}){in alphabet}Σ}
        = concat(L1,L2)"
proof-
  have lang1:"L1 {is a language with alphabet}Σ"
    using L1_def unfolding IsALanguage_def[OF fin] by auto
  have lang2:"L2 {is a language with alphabet}Σ"
    using L2_def unfolding IsALanguage_def[OF fin] by auto
  let ?s⇩0="⟨s01,0⟩"
  let ?S="concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  let ?t="concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  let ?F="F2×{1}"
  have ss:"?s⇩0∈?S" unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def using A1 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
  then have ss2:"{?s⇩0} ⊆ ?S" by auto
  then have ss3:"{?s⇩0}∈Pow(?S)" by auto
  {
    fix i assume "i∈{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ}"
    then have i:"i∈Lists(Σ)" "i <-ε-N (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ" by auto
    from i(2) have r:"(∃q∈Pow(?S). (ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q) ∩ ?F ≠ ∅) ∧
      (⟨⟨i, {?s⇩0}⟩, ∅, q⟩ ∈
      (({reduce ε-N-relation}(?S,?t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)))∨(i=0 ∧ ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{?s⇩0}) ∩ ?F ≠ ∅)"
      unfolding FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] i(1)] by auto
    {
      assume i0:"i=0" and ecl:"ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{?s⇩0}) ∩ ?F ≠ ∅"
      have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{?s⇩0}) = {?s⇩0}∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s01∈F1}" using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2 ss3] by auto
      moreover have "?s⇩0∉?F" by auto
      ultimately have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{?s⇩0}) ∩ ?F = {x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s01∈F1}∩?F" by auto
      with ecl obtain p where p:"p∈?F" "p∈{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. s01∈F1}" by auto
      {
        assume "s01∉F1"
        with p(2) have False by auto
      }
      then have s01F1:"s01∈F1" by auto
      with p(2) have "p=⟨s02,1⟩"  by auto
      with p(1) have s02F2:"s02∈F2" by auto
      from i(1) i0 have zero_L:"(0:Lists(Σ))" by auto
      have "0 <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ"
        unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A1 zero_L] using s01F1 by auto
      then have zero_L1:"(0:L1)" unfolding L1_def using zero_L by auto
      have "0 <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ"
        unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A2 zero_L] using s02F2 by auto
      then have zero_L2:"(0:L2)" unfolding L2_def using zero_L by auto
      have concat00:"Concat(0,0) = 0"
        unfolding Concat_def ShiftedSeq_def NatInterval_def by auto
      have "(0:concat(L1,L2))"
        unfolding concat_def[OF lang1 lang2]
        using zero_L2 zero_L1 concat00 by auto
      with i0 have "i:concat(L1,L2)" by auto
    } moreover
    {
      assume "¬(i=0 ∧ ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{?s⇩0}) ∩ ?F ≠ ∅)"
      with r obtain q where q:"q:Pow(?S)" "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q) ∩ ?F ≠ ∅" "⟨⟨i, {?s⇩0}⟩, ∅, q⟩ ∈
    (({reduce ε-N-relation}(?S,?t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)" by auto
      from q(1) have ecl_eq:"ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q) = q∪{x∈{⟨s02,1⟩}. q∩(F1×1)≠0}"
        using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
      then have "i:concat(L1,L2)"
      proof -
        let ?rε = "{reduce ε-N-relation}(?S,?t){in alphabet}Σ"
        let ?rD1 = "{reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ"
        let ?rD2 = "{reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ"
        have zero_L:"(0::i)∈Lists(Σ)"
          unfolding Lists_def Pi_def function_def using nat_0I by auto
        ― ‹Step 1: derive ‹i∈NELists(Σ)›.
            If ‹i=0› the ‹rε^*› run is the identity, forcing ‹q=\{s⇩0\}› and
            ‹ε-cl(\{s⇩0\})∩F≠∅›, which contradicts the surrounding negated assumption.›
        have iNE:"i∈NELists(Σ)"
        proof (rule ccontr)
          assume inoNE:"i∉NELists(Σ)"
          from i(1) obtain k where k:"k∈nat" "i:k→Σ" unfolding Lists_def by auto
          have "k=0"
          proof (rule ccontr)
            assume "k≠0"
            from k(1) this obtain p where p:"p∈nat" "k=succ(p)" using Nat_ZF_1_L3 by auto
            with k(2) have "i:succ(p)→Σ" by simp
            then have "i∈NELists(Σ)" unfolding NELists_def using p(1) by auto
            with inoNE show False by simp
          qed
          with k(2) have "i:0→Σ" by simp
