          then have i0:"i=0" unfolding Pi_def function_def by auto
          from q(3) i0 have run0:"⟨⟨0,{?s⇩0}⟩,0,q⟩∈?rε^*" by simp
          from rtrancl_rev[of ?rε] run0 have
            "⟨⟨0,{?s⇩0}⟩,0,q⟩∈id(field(?rε)) ∪
             (?rε^* O ?rε)" by auto
          moreover {
            assume "⟨⟨0,{?s⇩0}⟩,0,q⟩∈id(field(?rε))"
            then have "q={?s⇩0}" by auto
            with q(2) have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{?s⇩0})∩?F≠0" by simp
            with ‹¬(i=0 ∧ ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{?s⇩0}) ∩ ?F ≠ ∅)› i0 have False by auto
          }
          moreover {
            assume "⟨⟨0,{?s⇩0}⟩,0,q⟩∈?rε^* O ?rε"
            then obtain y where "⟨⟨0,{?s⇩0}⟩,y⟩∈?rε" using compE by auto
            then have "0∈NELists(Σ)"
              unfolding FullNFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin
                concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]] by auto
            then have False unfolding NELists_def Pi_def by auto
          }
          ultimately show False by auto
        qed
        ― ‹Step 2: apply ‹exec_state_form› to decompose ‹q›.›
        from exec_state_form[OF fin A1 A2 iNE q(3)] obtain q1 Q2 where qform:
          "q1∈S1" "Q2∈Pow(S2)" "q={⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}"
          "⟨⟨i,s01⟩,⟨0,q1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*"
          by auto
        ― ‹Step 3: ‹ε-cl(q)∩?F≠∅› forces ‹Q2∩F2≠∅› or ‹q1∈F1∧s02∈F2›.›
        have caseSplit:"Q2∩F2≠0 ∨ (q1∈F1 ∧ s02∈F2)"
        proof (rule ccontr)
          assume "¬(Q2∩F2≠0 ∨ (q1∈F1 ∧ s02∈F2))"
          then have Q2F2:"Q2∩F2=0" and notcA:"¬(q1∈F1 ∧ s02∈F2)" by auto
          {
            assume as:"q∩(F1×1)≠0"
            with qform(3) have "⟨q1,0⟩∈F1×1" by auto
            then have "q1∈F1" by auto
            with notcA have A:"s02∉F2" by auto
            from Q2F2 have "(Q2×{1})∩?F =0" by auto
            then have "q∩?F = 0" using qform(3) by auto moreover
            from as ecl_eq have "⟨s02,1⟩:ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q)" by auto
            ultimately have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q)∩?F = {⟨s02,1⟩}∩?F"
              using ecl_eq by auto
            with A have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q)∩?F = 0" by auto
            with q(2) have False by auto
          }
          then have "q∩(F1×1) =0" by auto
          then have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q) = q" using ecl_eq by auto
          then have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q)∩?F = q∩?F" by auto
          then have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q)∩?F = (Q2∩F2)×{1}" using qform(3) by auto
          with Q2F2 have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,q)∩?F = 0" by auto
          with q(2) show False by auto
        qed
        have D1:"DetFinStateAuto(S1,s01,t1,F1,Σ)"
          unfolding DetFinStateAuto_def using fin A1 by auto
        have D2:"DetFinStateAuto(S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
          unfolding DetFinStateAuto_def using fin A2 by auto
        have s01S1:"s01∈S1" using A1 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
        ― ‹‹Concat(0,i)=i›: used to build the witness ‹i=Concat(0,i)› in concat.›
        have C0i:"Concat(0,i)=i"
        proof -
          from i(1) obtain k where k:"k∈nat" "i:k→Σ" unfolding Lists_def by auto
          have zk:"(0::i):0→Σ" unfolding Pi_def function_def by auto
          have t1c:"Concat(0,i):k→Σ"
            using concat_props(1)[OF nat_0I k(1) zk k(2)] add_0 k(1) by simp
          have ptw:"∀j∈k. Concat(0,i)`j = i`j"
          proof
            fix j assume jk:"j∈k"
            from jk k(1) have jN:"j∈nat" using elem_nat_is_nat by blast
            then have s:"0 #+ j = j" by auto
            have jI:"0 #+ j∈NatInterval(0,k)"
              using jk unfolding NatInterval_def by auto
            from concat_props(3)[OF nat_0I k(1) zk k(2)] jI jN
            show "Concat(0,i)`j = i`j" by auto
          qed
          from t1c k(2) ptw show "Concat(0,i)=i"
            using fun_extension[of "Concat(0,i)" k "λ_. Σ" i "λ_. Σ"] by auto
        qed
        ― ‹Shared helper: ‹i∈L1› and ‹0∈L2› imply ‹i∈concat(L1,L2)› via ‹Concat(0,i)=i›.›
        have conc_from_L1_0L2:"i∈L1 ⟹ 0∈L2 ⟹ i∈concat(L1,L2)"
        proof -
          assume "i∈L1" "0∈L2"
          then have "⟨i,0⟩∈L1×L2" by auto
          then have "Concat(0,i):concat(L1,L2)" unfolding concat_def[OF lang1 lang2] by auto
          then show "i∈concat(L1,L2)" using C0i by auto
        qed
        have run_A2:"⟨⟨i,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩,⟨0,{⟨q1,0⟩}∪Q2×{1}⟩⟩∈?rε^*"
          using q(3) qform(3) by auto
        from caseSplit show "i∈concat(L1,L2)"
        proof (elim disjE)
          ― ‹Case B: pick ‹q2∈Q2∩F2› and apply ‹exec_A2_component›.›
          assume cB:"Q2∩F2≠0"
          then obtain q2 where q2:"q2∈Q2" "q2∈F2" by auto
          from exec_A2_component[OF fin A1 A2 iNE run_A2 qform(1) qform(2) q2(1)]
          show "i∈concat(L1,L2)"
          proof (elim disjE)
            ― ‹case\_a: A1 ran ‹i› to ‹yl_k∈NELists›, then A2 ran ‹yl_k› to ‹q2∈F2›.›
            assume "∃yl_k∈NELists(Σ). ∃f1∈F1.
                      ⟨⟨i,s01⟩,⟨yl_k,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^* ∧
                      ⟨⟨yl_k,s02⟩,⟨0,q2⟩⟩∈?rD2^*"
            then obtain yl_k f1 where
              yk_ne:"yl_k∈NELists(Σ)" and f1F1:"f1∈F1" and
              ca1:"⟨⟨i,s01⟩,⟨yl_k,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*" and
              ca2:"⟨⟨yl_k,s02⟩,⟨0,q2⟩⟩∈?rD2^*" by auto
            have ykL:"yl_k∈Lists(Σ)" using yk_ne unfolding NELists_def Lists_def by auto
            have yk_L2:"yl_k∈L2"
            proof -
              have "yl_k <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ"
                unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A2 ykL] using q2(2) ca2 by auto
              then show "yl_k∈L2" unfolding L2_def using ykL by auto
            qed
            from DetFinStateAuto.list_prefix_split[OF D1 ca1] obtain jl where
              jl_L:"jl∈Lists(Σ)" and i_spl:"i=Concat(yl_k,jl)" by auto
            ― ‹‹jl∈L1›: if ‹jl=0› use determinism to get ‹s01∈F1›;
                otherwise apply ‹dfa_run_suffix›.›
            have jlL1:"jl∈L1"
            proof -
              {
                assume jl0:"jl=0"
                have ieq:"i=yl_k"
                  using jl0 i_spl concat_empty ykL unfolding Lists_def by auto
                with ca1 have same:"⟨⟨yl_k,s01⟩,⟨yl_k,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*" by simp
                have fld:"⟨yl_k,s01⟩∈field(?rD1)"
                  using DetFinStateAuto.reduce_field(2)[OF D1] yk_ne s01S1 by auto
                have id_r:"⟨⟨yl_k,s01⟩,⟨yl_k,s01⟩⟩∈?rD1^*"
                  using rtrancl_refl fld by auto
                from DetFinStateAuto.relation_deteministic[OF D1 same id_r]
                have "f1=s01" .
                with f1F1 have s01F1:"s01∈F1" by simp
                have "0 <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ"
                  unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A1 zero_L] using s01F1 by auto
                with jl0 have "jl∈L1" unfolding L1_def using zero_L by auto
              } moreover {
                assume "jl≠0"
                from jl_L obtain m where m:"m∈nat" "jl:m→Σ"
                  unfolding Lists_def by auto
                  {
                    assume "m=0"
                    with m(2) have "jl=0" by auto
                    with ‹jl≠0› have False by auto
                  }
                with m(1) obtain p where p:"p∈nat" "m=succ(p)"
                  using Nat_ZF_1_L3 by auto
                with m(2) have jlNE:"jl∈NELists(Σ)"
                  unfolding NELists_def using p(1) by auto
                from i_spl ca1 have
                  rspl:"⟨⟨Concat(yl_k,jl),s01⟩,⟨yl_k,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*" by simp
                from DetFinStateAuto.dfa_run_suffix[OF D1 ykL jlNE rspl]
                have rjl:"⟨⟨jl,s01⟩,⟨0,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*" .
                have "jl <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ"
                  unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A1 jl_L] using f1F1 rjl by auto
                then have "jl∈L1" unfolding L1_def using jl_L by auto
              }
              ultimately show "jl∈L1" by auto
            qed
            show "i∈concat(L1,L2)"
              unfolding concat_def[OF lang1 lang2] i_spl using jlL1 yk_L2 by auto
          next
            ― ‹case\_b: ‹q2=s02› and A1 ran all of ‹i› to some ‹f1∈F1›.›
            assume cb:"q2=s02 ∧ (∃f1∈F1. ⟨⟨i,s01⟩,⟨0,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*)"
            then have s02F2:"s02∈F2" using q2(2) by auto
            from cb obtain f1 where f1F1:"f1∈F1" and
              cb1:"⟨⟨i,s01⟩,⟨0,f1⟩⟩∈?rD1^*" by auto
            have iL1:"i∈L1"
            proof -
              have "i <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ"
                unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A1 i(1)] using f1F1 cb1 by auto
              then show "i∈L1" unfolding L1_def using i(1) by auto
            qed
            have zL2:"0∈L2"
            proof -
              have "0 <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ"
                unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A2 zero_L] using s02F2 by auto
              then show "0∈L2" unfolding L2_def using zero_L by auto
            qed
            show "i∈concat(L1,L2)" using conc_from_L1_0L2 iL1 zL2 by auto
          qed
        next
          ― ‹Case A: ‹q1∈F1› and ‹s02∈F2›.  A1 accepted ‹i›; ‹0∈L2› by ‹s02∈F2›.›
          assume cA:"q1∈F1 ∧ s02∈F2"
          then have q1F1:"q1∈F1" and s02F2:"s02∈F2" by auto
          have iL1:"i∈L1"
          proof -
            have "i <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ"
              unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A1 i(1)] using q1F1 qform(4) by auto
            then show "i∈L1" unfolding L1_def using i(1) by auto
          qed
          have zL2:"0∈L2"
          proof -
            have "0 <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ"
              unfolding DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A2 zero_L] using s02F2 by auto
            then show "0∈L2" unfolding L2_def using zero_L by auto
          qed
          show "i∈concat(L1,L2)" using conc_from_L1_0L2 iL1 zL2 by auto
        qed
      qed
    } ultimately
    have "i:concat(L1,L2)" by auto
  } moreover
  {
    fix i assume "i:concat(L1,L2)"
    then obtain j u where uj:"u∈L2" "j∈L1" "i=Concat(u,j)" using concat_def[OF lang1 lang2] by auto
    from uj have c:"Concat(u,j)∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding L1_def L2_def using concat_type by auto
    {
      assume j0:"j≠0" moreover
      from uj(1) have uu:"u∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding L2_def by auto moreover
      have "{⟨s01,0⟩}⊆S1×1" using A1 unfolding DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
      then have "{⟨s01,0⟩}∈Pow(?S)" unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def by auto
      ultimately obtain Q1 where A:"Q1∈Pow(?S)" "⟨s02,1⟩∈Q1" 
        "⟨⟨Concat(u,j),{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩,u,Q1⟩∈(({reduce ε-N-relation}(?S,?t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)"
        using concat_FSA_apply_L1[OF fin A1 A2, of j "{⟨s01,0⟩}" u] uj(2) unfolding L1_def
        by auto
      from A have A22:"⟨s02,1⟩∈ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,Q1)"
        using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2] by auto
      {
        assume u0:"u≠0"
        from concat_FSA_apply_L2[OF fin A1 A2 _ A22 A(1) u0] uj(1)
          obtain Q2 where B:"Q2∈Pow(?S)" " ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,Q2)∩?F≠0"
          "⟨⟨u,Q1⟩,0,Q2⟩∈(({reduce ε-N-relation}(?S,?t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)"
          unfolding L2_def by auto
        from A(3) B(3) have "⟨⟨Concat(u,j),{?s⇩0}⟩,0,Q2⟩∈(({reduce ε-N-relation}(?S,?t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)"
          using trans_rtrancl[of "({reduce ε-N-relation}(?S,?t){in alphabet}Σ)"]
          unfolding trans_def by auto
        then have "Concat(u,j) <-ε-N (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ"
          using FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]] B(1,2)
          c by auto
        with uj(3) c have "i:{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ}" by auto
      } moreover
      {
        assume u0:"u=0"
        {
          assume "s02∈F2"
          with A(2) have "Q1∩?F≠0" by auto moreover
          from A(1) have "Q1 ⊆ ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,Q1)" using epsilon_cl_refl_sub[OF fin
            concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]] by auto
          ultimately have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,Q1)∩?F≠0" by auto
          with A(1,3) have "Concat(u,j) <-ε-N (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ"
            using FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2], of "Concat(u,j)"]
            c `u=0` by auto
          with uj(3) c have "i:{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ}" by auto
        } moreover
        {
          assume G:"s02∉F2"
          let ?dr="{reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ"
          have "0:0→Σ" unfolding Pi_def function_def by auto
          then have l0:"0∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding Lists_def by blast
          from u0 uj(1) have "0 <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ" unfolding L2_def by auto
          with l0 obtain q where q:"q∈F2" "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)^*" 
            using DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A2, of 0] G by auto
          {
            assume "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∈id(field(?dr))"
            then have False using G q(1) by auto
          }
          then have "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∉id(field(?dr))" by auto moreover
          from q(2) have "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∈id(field(?dr))∪(?dr^* O ?dr)" using rtrancl_rev
            by auto
          ultimately have "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∈(?dr^* O ?dr)" by auto
          then obtain y where y:"⟨⟨0,s02⟩,y⟩∈?dr" "⟨y,⟨0,q⟩⟩∈?dr^*" using compE by auto
          from y(1) have "0∈NELists(Σ)" unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A2]
            by auto
          then have False unfolding NELists_def Pi_def by auto
        }
        ultimately have "i:{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ}" by auto
      }
      ultimately have "i:{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ}" by auto
    } moreover
    {
      assume j0:"j=0"
      then have iu:"i=u" using concat_empty uj(3) uj(1) unfolding L2_def Lists_def by auto
      have "0:0→Σ" unfolding Pi_def function_def by auto
      then have l0:"0∈Lists(Σ)" unfolding Lists_def by blast
      {
        assume G:"s01∉F1"
        let ?dr="{reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ"
        from j0 uj(2) have "0 <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ" unfolding L1_def by auto
        with l0 obtain q where q:"q∈F1" "⟨⟨0,s01⟩,0,q⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S1,t1){in alphabet}Σ)^*" 
          using DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A1, of 0] G by auto
        {
          assume "⟨⟨0,s01⟩,0,q⟩∈id(field(?dr))"
          then have False using G q(1) by auto
        }
        then have "⟨⟨0,s01⟩,0,q⟩∉id(field(?dr))" by auto moreover
        from q(2) have "⟨⟨0,s01⟩,0,q⟩∈id(field(?dr))∪(?dr^* O ?dr)" using rtrancl_rev
          by auto
        ultimately have "⟨⟨0,s01⟩,0,q⟩∈(?dr^* O ?dr)" by auto
        then obtain y where y:"⟨⟨0,s01⟩,y⟩∈?dr" "⟨y,⟨0,q⟩⟩∈?dr^*" using compE by auto
        from y(1) have "0∈NELists(Σ)" unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A1]
          by auto
        then have False unfolding NELists_def Pi_def by auto
      }
      then have "s01∈F1" by auto moreover
      have p:"{⟨s01,0⟩}:Pow(?S)" using A1 unfolding concat_eNFSA_states_def
        DFSA_def[OF fin] by auto
      ultimately have B:"ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{⟨s01,0⟩}) = {⟨s01,0⟩,⟨s02,1⟩}"
        using concat_eNFSA_eps_closure[OF fin A1 A2, of "{⟨s01,0⟩}"] by auto
      {
        assume u0:"u=0"
        {
          assume G:"s02∉F2"
          let ?dr="{reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ"
          from u0 uj(1) have "0 <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ" unfolding L2_def by auto
          with l0 obtain q where q:"q∈F2" "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∈({reduce D-relation}(S2,t2){in alphabet}Σ)^*" 
            using DFSASatisfy_def[OF fin A2, of 0] G by auto
          {
            assume "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∈id(field(?dr))"
            then have False using G q(1) by auto
          }
          then have "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∉id(field(?dr))" by auto moreover
          from q(2) have "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∈id(field(?dr))∪(?dr^* O ?dr)" using rtrancl_rev
            by auto
          ultimately have "⟨⟨0,s02⟩,0,q⟩∈(?dr^* O ?dr)" by auto
          then obtain y where y:"⟨⟨0,s02⟩,y⟩∈?dr" "⟨y,⟨0,q⟩⟩∈?dr^*" using compE by auto
          from y(1) have "0∈NELists(Σ)" unfolding DFSAExecutionRelation_def[OF fin A2]
            by auto
          then have False unfolding NELists_def Pi_def by auto
        }
        then have "s02∈F2" by auto
        then have A:"⟨s02,1⟩∈?F" by auto
        from A B have "ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{⟨s01,0⟩}) ∩?F ≠0" by auto
        with iu u0 have "i=0 ∧ ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{⟨s01,0⟩}) ∩?F ≠0" by auto
        then have "i:{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ}" 
            using FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
            l0 iu u0 by auto
      } moreover
      {
        assume u0:"u≠0"
        from B have B:"⟨s02,1⟩∈ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,{⟨s01,0⟩})" by auto
        from concat_FSA_apply_L2[OF fin A1 A2 _ B p u0] uj(1) B
          obtain Q2 where B:"Q2∈Pow(?S)" " ε-cl(?S,?t,Σ,Q2)∩?F≠0"
          "⟨⟨u,{⟨s01,0⟩}⟩,0,Q2⟩∈(({reduce ε-N-relation}(?S,?t){in alphabet}Σ)^*)"
          unfolding L2_def by auto
        then have "i:{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ}" using iu uj(1) unfolding L2_def
            using FullNFSASatisfy_def[OF fin concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2]]
            by auto
      }
      ultimately have "i:{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ}" by auto
    }
    ultimately have "i:{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N
            (?S,?s⇩0,?t,?F){in alphabet}Σ}" by auto
  }
  ultimately show ?thesis by blast
qed

text‹The concatenation of two regular languages is regular.›

theorem concat_language_regular:
  assumes fin:"Finite(Σ)"
  and "L1{is a regular language on}Σ"
  and "L2{is a regular language on}Σ"
  shows "concat(L1,L2) {is a regular language on}Σ"
proof-
  from fin assms(2) obtain S1 s01 t1 F1 where
    A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    and "L1 = DetFinStateAuto.LanguageDFSA(S1,s01,t1,F1,Σ)"
    using IsRegularLanguage_def by auto
  then have A1:"(S1,s01,t1,F1){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    and L1_eq:"L1 = {i∈Lists(Σ). i <-D (S1,s01,t1,F1){in alphabet}Σ}"
    using DetFinStateAuto_def fin A1 by auto
  from fin assms(3) obtain S2 s02 t2 F2 where
    A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    and "L2 = DetFinStateAuto.LanguageDFSA(S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
    using IsRegularLanguage_def by auto
  then have A2:"(S2,s02,t2,F2){is an DFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    and L2_eq:"L2 = {i∈Lists(Σ). i <-D (S2,s02,t2,F2){in alphabet}Σ}"
    using DetFinStateAuto_def fin A2 by auto
  let ?SS = "concat_eNFSA_states(S1,S2)"
  let ?s0 = "⟨s01,0⟩"
  let ?tc = "concat_eNFSA_trans(S1,s01,t1,F1,S2,s02,t2,F2,Σ)"
  let ?Fc = "F2×{1}"
  have valid:"(?SS,?s0,?tc,?Fc){is an ε-NFSA for alphabet}Σ"
    using concat_eNFSA_valid[OF fin A1 A2] .
  have lang_eq:"{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N (?SS,?s0,?tc,?Fc){in alphabet}Σ} = concat(L1,L2)"
    using concat_eNFSA_language[OF fin A1 A2 L1_eq L2_eq] .
  have "{i∈Lists(Σ). i <-ε-N (?SS,?s0,?tc,?Fc){in alphabet}Σ} {is a regular language on}Σ"
    using epsilonNFSA_lang_is_regular[OF fin valid] .
  with lang_eq show ?thesis by auto
qed

end
